meaning.en: Pops into view with a small bounce
meaning.ru: Выпрыгивает с лёгким пружинящим отскоком

ask.en: Bring the logo in with a pop-in, about 0.4 s, with a slight overshoot.
ask.ru: Логотип — поп-ин за 0.4 с, лёгкий перелёт.

summary: An app icon pops in with a bounce, then a notification badge pops in a moment later.
spec: One pop per 2.35 s (twice per 4.7 s cycle: a star on coral first, then a heart on blue).
Icon: 116 px rounded square (radius 30). From 0.28 s, scale 0→1 with a spring: 1 − e^(−6.5t)·cos(15t), peaking at about 1.26.
At the same time, rotation −0.35 rad (about −20°) → 0 with a spring: 1 − e^(−6t)·cos(11t).
Badge: yellow circle, radius 25, with "1", at the icon's top-right (+52, −52). Starts at 0.62 s with spring 1 − e^(−7t)·cos(17t).
Exit: 1.86–2.12 s. Scale is multiplied by (1 − backIn, s = 2.2), so it swells slightly and then shrinks to 0.
Floor shadow: 62 × 8 ellipse that scales with the icon (clamped to 0–1).
use: Use it to bring in a small element such as an icon, button or badge with a light accent.

meaning.en: Items appear one after another, slightly offset in time
meaning.ru: Элементы появляются по очереди с небольшим сдвигом

ask.en: Bring in the five cards with a stagger, 0.08 s apart, left to right.
ask.ru: Пять карточек стаггером, слева направо, шаг 3 кадра.

summary: Chart bars rise one after another from the left, each slightly delayed.
spec: One pass per 2.35 s. Seven bars (width 44, gap 20, heights 52, 84, 68, 112, 92, 136, 158), coloured blue, coral, yellow, mint in rotation.
Bar i (0-based) starts at 0.15 + 0.12·i s and grows from 0 to full height in 0.5 s with backOut (s = 2.6), anchored at the baseline, overshooting and settling.
White dot (radius 6.5, 16 px above the bar top): starts 0.34 s after its bar with spring 1 − e^(−7t)·cos(16t).
Exit: bars shrink with cubic ease-in over 0.26 s starting at 1.78 + 0.045·i s; dots vanish first, over 0.2 s from 1.70 + 0.045·i s.
use: Use it to bring in several items (list rows, chart bars, cards) in sequence and lead the eye across them.

meaning.en: Lines and dots burst outward as something appears
meaning.ru: Кольцо, лучи и точки разлетаются из центра в момент акцента

ask.en: Add a burst around the heart the moment it appears: 8 short lines that fade in 0.3 s.
ask.ru: На ударе — бёрст вокруг иконки, лучи акцентным цветом.

summary: A like heart fills in, and a ring, lines and dots burst outward at the same moment.
spec: One burst per 2.35 s. A heart (size 46, 7 px outline) sits in the centre.
Anticipation: 0.3–0.5 s, scale 1→0.7 (quadratic ease-in-out).
Trigger at 0.5 s: the heart fills with coral and scale returns 0.7→1 with spring 1 − e^(−6.5t)·cos(16t).
Ring: yellow, radius 44→90 while line width goes 16→0, over 0.6 s with quintic ease-out.
10 radial lines (yellow/mint alternating, width 9): outer end radius 64→130 (y scaled 0.82); length 36 shrinks to 0 between 0.22 and 0.7 s after the trigger.
10 dots (coral/blue alternating, radius 8→4.8): radius 58→150 on an ellipse (x ×1.45, y ×0.78), fading out 0.3–0.72 s after the trigger. The heart fill fades at 1.92–2.2 s.
use: Use it to mark the instant something is triggered or achieved, such as a like, a success or a correct answer.

meaning.en: A line extends as if it were being drawn
meaning.ru: Линия рисует сама себя от начала к концу

ask.en: Reveal the chart line with a line draw from the left, over 1.2 s.
ask.ru: График роста прорисовывается за секунду, потом стирается с начала.

summary: A chart line draws itself on, and is later erased from its starting end.
spec: One pass per 4.7 s. Drawn as a trim path: animate the visible range (start fraction to end fraction) of each stroke.
Axes (L shape, width 6) draw at 0.08–0.7 s; the line (mint, width 11, a smooth curve through 7 points, round caps) draws at 0.4–1.95 s. Both use cubic ease-in-out.
While drawing, a yellow dot (radius 12, white centre radius 5) rides the leading tip.
Arrowhead: opens at 1.9–2.2 s with backOut (s = 2.5); wings 26 long, 20 wide.
A coral circle (radius 26, width 7) is drawn around one peak at 2.2–2.8 s, clockwise from the top.
Erase: circle 3.5–4.0 s, line 3.65–4.45 s, axes 3.85–4.55 s, each shrinking from its starting end. The arrowhead fades at 4.3–4.45 s.
use: Use it when the stroke itself is the point: charts, routes, underlines, hand-drawn circles.

meaning.en: Text rises into view from behind an invisible edge
meaning.ru: Текст выезжает из-за невидимого края

ask.en: Bring the title in with a mask reveal from below, 0.6 s, each line slightly after the one before.
ask.ru: Заголовок маск-ривилом снизу вверх, по строке.

summary: Headline text slides out from behind an invisible edge marked by a single line.
spec: One pass per 2.35 s. Divider line (coral, 380 × 6, y = 124): grows from the centre at 0.1–0.5 s (cubic ease-in-out), shrinks away at 2.05–2.3 s.
Top text (bold 98 px, white): clipped to the area above the line (y 8–119); moves up into place from 120 px below at 0.35–1.0 s, quintic ease-out.
Bottom text (32 px, yellow): clipped to the area below the line (y 129–181); moves down into place from 60 px above at 0.55–1.15 s, quintic ease-out.
Exit: top text moves 150 px up at 1.7–2.05 s (backIn, s = 1.2, dipping slightly first); bottom text moves 70 px down at 1.75–2.05 s (cubic ease-in).
Opacity never changes; the text is hidden only by leaving the clip area.
use: Use it for titles and headings that should appear in a clean, composed way.

meaning.en: Text appears one character at a time, as if typed
meaning.ru: Текст набирается по одному символу

ask.en: Show this sentence with a typewriter effect, 0.05 s per character, with a cursor at the end.
ask.ru: Промпт печатается в поле ввода, потом нажимается «Отправить».

summary: Text is typed into an input field one character at a time, then the send button lights up and is pressed.
spec: One pass per 4.7 s. Nine characters appear in a white input field (471 × 92, radius 30), one every 0.24 s starting at 0.3 s (typing ends at 2.46 s).
Each new character settles from scale 1.35 to 1: 1 + 0.35·e^(−16t).
Cursor (coral, 5 × 44) sits after the last character: solid while typing, otherwise blinking with a 0.94 s period (on for 0.5 s).
Send button (radius 30): grey, then a blue disc appears from 2.58 s with spring 1 − e^(−6.5t)·cos(15t).
Press: the button shrinks by up to 20% at 2.96–3.21 s (half sine). At 3.13–3.41 s the text moves 70 px up while fading out.
The cursor returns to the start once the text is half faded (about 3.27 s); at 3.51–3.81 s the blue fades.
use: Use it to show someone typing: a prompt, a search query, a chat message.

meaning.en: A number runs up quickly to its final value
meaning.ru: Число бежит вверх и фиксируется на итоговом значении

ask.en: Count the figure up from 0 to 1,280 in 1.5 s, slowing down at the end.
ask.ru: Счётчик 0 → 10 000 за 1.5 с, замедление в конце.

summary: A number races upward and locks onto its final value.
spec: One pass per 4.7 s. Fades in at 0.1–0.4 s and out at 4.0–4.4 s.
Number (bold 104 px): 0→2,480 over 0.45–2.9 s. Value = round(target × (1 − (1 − p)^4)): fast at first, slow at the end.
Thousands separator included. Every digit has the same width and the number is right-aligned, so it does not jitter sideways.
Lands at 2.9 s: colour switches white→yellow and scale does a small bounce, 1 + 0.07·e^(−7t)·cos(15t).
Up-arrow chip on the left (mint circle, radius 34): appears from 0.35 s with spring 1 − e^(−7t)·cos(14t); while counting it shakes vertically by 6 px × (1 − p)^3 × sin(30u).
Bar below (330 × 12, blue→mint gradient): fills in proportion to value ÷ target.
use: Use it to make a figure feel big or growing: revenue, user counts, completion rates.

name.ja: キネティックタイポグラフィ

meaning.en: Words move, scale and turn in time with what is said
meaning.ru: Слова двигаются так, как они звучат по смыслу

ask.en: Turn this narration into kinetic typography: make the stressed words larger and land them on the beat.
ask.ru: Каждое слово — своя анимация по смыслу: «БЫСТРО» растягивается, «СТОП» впечатывается.

summary: Words move the way they mean: one stretches, one bounces, one spins, one slams down.
spec: Four words, 1.175 s each (bold 88 px). Each exits in its last 0.2 s, fading out while moving 46 px up (cubic ease-in).
Stretch (blue): horizontal scale 0.3→1 with spring 1 − e^(−4.2t)·cos(12t); vertical scale is 1/√(horizontal).
Bounce (yellow): characters staggered by 0.1 s; height 78 px × |sin(πt/0.4)| × e^(−2.6t); squashed vertically by up to 16% at each contact.
Spin (mint): characters staggered by 0.12 s; rotation −360°→0° over 0.62 s with backOut (s = 1.3); scale 0→1 over 0.25 s, cubic ease-out.
Slam (coral, 100 px, slanted): scale 3.4→1 at 0.02–0.2 s with cubic ease-in.
After impact: horizontal shake 10 px × e^(−9t) × sin(38t), vertical squash 20% × e^(−11t), and 8 radial lines for 0.4 s.
use: Use it to make key words from narration or lyrics memorable through how they move.

meaning.en: Motion speeds up and slows down instead of moving at one speed
meaning.ru: Движение разгоняется и тормозит, а не едет с постоянной скоростью

ask.en: Add easing to this move: ease-out, slowing down as it stops.
ask.ru: Никакого линейного движения: все входы ease-out, выходы ease-in.

summary: Two squares cover the same distance in the same time: the top one at constant speed, the bottom one eased.
spec: One round trip per 4.7 s. Two 62 px squares (radius 16) travel 316 px horizontally: out at 0.2–1.75 s (1.55 s), hold 0.8 s, back at 2.55–4.1 s.
Top (constant): linear motion; shape and colour never change.
Bottom (eased): cubic-bezier(.86, 0, .14, 1). Slow start, very fast middle, slow stop.
The bottom square stretches horizontally up to 1.5× and flattens to 0.8× in proportion to speed (speed ÷ 3.6, clamped to 0–1).
Behind it: 3 speed lines (up to 150 px × 0.8–1.25) and 4 ghost copies lagging 0.035 s each.
Each rail shows 12 dots marking positions at equal time intervals (evenly spaced on top, bunched at both ends below).
use: Use it on any move, scale or rotation so the motion accelerates and decelerates instead of looking mechanical.

meaning.en: Goes a little past the target, then settles back
meaning.ru: Проскакивает цель, возвращается и успокаивается

ask.en: Give the gauge needle an overshoot: about 10% past the target, then back.
ask.ru: Стрелка шкалы с перелётом: чуть дальше и назад.

summary: A gauge needle swings past its target, comes back and settles.
spec: One pass per 4.7 s. Semicircular gauge (radius 128, stroke 26). Target is 0.7 of the sweep (126° from the left end).
Starts at 0.25 s: value = 0.7 × (1 − e^(−4.6t)·cos(10.5t)). About 0.3 s later it is roughly 25% past the target, then it oscillates and settles on the target.
The part beyond the target is drawn in coral. A yellow tick marks the target.
The filled arc is a blue→mint gradient; the needle is white, width 9.
Return: from 3.7 s, value = 0.7 × e^(−7.5t)·cos(8.5t) back to 0 (dipping slightly below 0 before it stops).
use: Use it to give an arriving element energy and a springy feel.

name.ja: スクワッシュ＆ストレッチ

meaning.en: Squashes and stretches so that it feels elastic
meaning.ru: Объект сплющивается при ударе и вытягивается в полёте

ask.en: Add squash and stretch when the ball lands; keep the squash subtle.
ask.ru: Мячик прыгает со сквош-энд-стретч, сильнее на приземлении.

summary: A bouncing character squashes on landing and stretches as it takes off.
spec: A round character, radius 37. One bounce per 1.175 s (four per 4.7 s), a 92 px parabola. It drifts ±150 px sideways on a sine wave over the cycle.
On the ground (first and last 10% of each bounce): vertical scale goes between 0.52 (moment of impact) and 1.28 (moment of leaving) on a quadratic curve.
In the air: vertical scale = 1 + 0.28 × s^3, where s is the time offset from the apex (0 at the apex, 1 at take-off and touchdown), so it is stretched where it moves fast.
Horizontal scale is always 1 ÷ vertical (volume is preserved). The transform is anchored at the feet.
The shadow gets smaller and thinner with height. Short yellow lines flick out left and right at each landing (for about 18% of a bounce).
use: Use it to give a character or logo weight and softness.

meaning.en: One shape turns smoothly into another
meaning.ru: Одна фигура плавно перетекает в другую

ask.en: Morph the circle into a star in 0.8 s, changing the color from blue to yellow on the way.
ask.ru: Круг → квадрат → звезда, вместе с цветом, по 12 кадров.

summary: A shape changes smoothly from circle to square to star to heart, with its colour.
spec: Four shapes, 1.175 s each: circle → square with rounded-off corners → star → heart → back to circle. Base radius 64.
Each segment holds first, then morphs to the next shape between 0.62 s and 0.04 s before its end (0.58 s).
Every outline is stored as 240 points; points with the same index are linearly interpolated. Progress uses backOut (s = 1.6), so it overshoots slightly.
Colour: blue → coral → yellow → mint, blended with quadratic ease-in-out.
During the morph the scale swells by 1 + 0.07 × sin(π × progress).
Four dots below; the dot for the current shape is larger and coloured.
use: Use it to turn one icon or logo into another without a cut.

meaning.en: Shapes move and merge like liquid
meaning.ru: Капля тянется, рвётся на капли и сливается обратно

ask.en: Make the logo entrance a liquid motion: drops gather and form the shape.
ask.ru: Логотип собирается из жидких капель (goo).

summary: A blob stretches out, breaks into drops and merges back into one.
spec: Lead circle (radius 44): moves 300 px right at 0.35–1.45 s with cubic-bezier(.7, 0, .2, 1), rising 34 px on a sine arc while moving; returns the same way at 2.7–3.8 s.
Seven circles follow the same path, each 0.065 s later, radius tapering 44→15, wobbling ±6 px vertically.
Even while it rests, three small circles (radius 15, 13, 11) move in and out between 34 and 64 px from it, twice per cycle.
Merged look: draw the circles in white → blur 9 px → threshold the alpha (soft only between 112 and 144) → fill what remains with colour.
Fill is a diagonal gradient mint → blue → violet (#7C5CFF), with a white elliptical highlight on the lead circle.
use: Use it for an organic, soft look in logos, backgrounds and connecting moves.

meaning.en: A fading trail follows a moving object
meaning.ru: Объект оставляет за собой затухающие копии

ask.en: Add a motion trail to the flying circle: five copies that fade out behind it.
ask.ru: Слово летит со шлейфом из 5 копий.

summary: A ball moving in a figure eight leaves a fading trail of copies behind it.
spec: A ball (coral, radius 25, white centre radius 11) traces a figure eight once per 4.7 s: x = 196·sin(a), y = 62·sin(2a), with a advancing at constant speed.
15 copies, each placed 0.105 rad (about 0.079 s) further back along the path.
Copy radius goes 22→6 and opacity is 0.9 × (1 − i/15) + 0.05, so older copies are smaller and fainter.
Copy colour runs coral → yellow → blue from newest to oldest.
Draw the oldest copy first and the ball itself last.
use: Use it to show speed or a path: flying objects, cursors, points of light.

meaning.en: Many small pieces fly out and scatter
meaning.ru: Поток частиц вылетает, разлетается и падает

ask.en: At the moment of success, shoot particles up from the bottom: four colors, all fallen within 1.5 s.
ask.ru: Искры летят из-под логотипа, гаснут по дороге.

summary: Particles keep shooting up from an emitter, spread out and fall.
spec: 84 particles, emitted from the bottom centre (horizontal centre, 20 px above the bottom edge).
Initial velocity: ±190 px/s horizontally, 250–400 px/s upward. Gravity 470 px/s² (parabolic paths).
Each particle repeats with a period of 2.35 s or about 1.57 s, with a random start offset (fixed seed, so every run looks the same).
Lifetime up to 1.5 s: fade in over the first 0.06 s, fade out over the last 30%. Scale 1.15→0.7.
Shapes are circles, squares and triangles (size 5–11 px) in blue, coral, yellow and mint, spinning at up to ±4.5 rad/s.
use: Use it to add celebration or liveliness, in place of confetti or sparks.

meaning.en: Near and far layers move at different speeds to show depth
meaning.ru: Ближние слои двигаются сильнее дальних — появляется глубина

ask.en: Split this landscape into three layers and scroll them with parallax, nearer layers faster.
ask.ru: Три слоя с параллаксом, ближний в 3 раза быстрее дальнего.

summary: A landscape pans sideways; near layers move more and far layers move less, creating depth.
spec: Camera pan: ±108 px on a sine wave, one round trip per 4.7 s.
Each layer is offset by pan × factor in the opposite direction. Factors from back to front: stars 0.05, moon 0.1, far ridge 0.28, middle ridge 0.6, front hill and trees 1.25, nearest dark shapes 2.1.
Far layers use darker colours close to the background, nearer layers brighter ones; the nearest layer is a large dark silhouette along the bottom.
Every layer is drawn at least 200 px beyond both sides of the frame so its ends never show.
use: Use it to give flat artwork or photos depth: backgrounds, landscapes, scrolling scenes.

name.ja: マスクトランジション

meaning.en: The next scene appears inside a growing shape
meaning.ru: Окно-фигура растёт и открывает следующую сцену

ask.en: Go to the next scene with a mask transition: a circle grows from the center in 0.7 s.
ask.ru: Переход кругом из центра, с обводкой по краю.

summary: A circle- or star-shaped window grows, showing the next scene inside it.
spec: Day scene → night scene → day scene, 2.35 s each. The change runs at 0.45–1.6 s of each half (1.15 s), cubic ease-in-out.
The next scene is drawn on top of the current one, clipped to a shape; the shape grows until it covers the frame.
Day→night: a circle from the sun's centre (112, 104), radius 0→470.
Night→day: a five-point star from the moon's centre (427, 104), outer radius 0→1150, rotating 1.2 rad (about 69°) as it grows.
While it grows, the edge of the shape has a white outline (width 7).
use: Use it to change scenes starting from an object in the frame, such as a sun, logo or button.

name.ja: シェイプトランジション

meaning.en: Shapes cover the screen and uncover the next scene
meaning.ru: Цветные полосы закрывают кадр, уходят — и там новая сцена

ask.en: Change scenes with a shape transition: four diagonal color bands sweep in from the left.
ask.ru: Три цветные полосы наискосок как переход, 12 кадров.

summary: Coloured bands sweep across and cover the frame; when they leave, the next scene is there.
spec: Day → night → day, 2.35 s each. Four horizontal bands (height 52; blue, coral, yellow, mint) whose ends are slanted by 80 px.
Cover: 0.38–1.0 s. Each band's leading edge travels from one side of the frame to the other. Bands are delayed by 14% of the phase each, and each uses cubic ease-in-out over 58% of the phase.
At 1.0 s, when everything is covered, the scene underneath is swapped for the next one.
Uncover: 1.12–1.75 s. Each band's trailing edge follows with the same delays and curve, exposing the next scene.
Direction: left to right for day→night, mirrored for night→day.
use: Use it to change scenes with shapes in brand colours: chapter breaks, topic changes.

name.ja: リキッドトランジション

meaning.en: Liquid flows in and replaces the scene
meaning.ru: Жидкость заливает кадр и становится следующей сценой

ask.en: Use a liquid transition here: blue ink drips down from the top and fills the frame.
ask.ru: Переход жидкой заливкой снизу, мениск акцентным цветом.

summary: Paint-like liquid drips down from the top and fills the frame, becoming the next scene.
spec: Day → night → day, 2.35 s each. Two liquid layers, both moving top to bottom with quadratic ease-in-out.
Layer 1 (flat colour: blue for day→night, coral for night→day): 0.35–1.5 s. Layer 2 (the next scene itself, clipped to the liquid shape): 0.7–1.8 s.
The liquid front moves from y = −110 to 130 px below the bottom edge. Its edge waves with two sine waves (amplitudes 13 px and 8 px), strongest midway.
Seven drips (30–54 px wide, round tips) hang from the front; length = base 30–110 px × (0.25 + 0.9 × wave strength), greatest midway.
Merged look: draw the shape in white → blur 7 px → threshold the alpha → fill with the colour (or the next scene).
use: Use it for a soft, organic scene change, for example in food, beauty or creative videos.

meaning.en: Zooms into an object and passes through it into the next scene
meaning.ru: Камера влетает в букву или отверстие и вылетает в новой сцене

ask.en: Zoom through the hole of the "O" in the logo into the next scene, 0.6 s, accelerating.
ask.ru: Влетаем в букву «О» и вылетаем в следующую сцену.

summary: The camera pushes into the hole of a letter O and comes out in the next scene.
spec: Scene X (ZOOM on yellow) → scene Y (GO! on blue) → scene X, 2.35 s each.
The current scene is scaled around the centre of an O's hole (radius 24.5). Maximum scale is 1.08× the value at which the hole covers the whole frame (about 14×).
Scale = maxScale^p (exponential zoom, which reads as constant speed).
p = 0.8 × cubic ease-in (0.25–1.2 s) + 0.2 × cubic ease-out (1.2–1.65 s): accelerate in, slow down at the end.
Inside the hole the next scene is placed at 1/maxScale. When the zoom ends it is exactly at full size, and the view switches to the next scene.
use: Use it to dive into a logo or letter and move to the next scene with momentum.

meaning.en: Turns over like a card to show the other side
meaning.ru: Карточка переворачивается и показывает обратную сторону

ask.en: Flip the pricing card to show the details on its back, in 0.5 s.
ask.ru: Карточка «до» флипом переворачивается в «после».

summary: A card turns over around its vertical axis and shows its other side.
spec: A card (300 × 156, radius 22). Front (blue, Q) ⇄ back (yellow, A), 2.35 s each.
Rotates 180° at 0.45–1.5 s (1.05 s) with backOut (s = 1.5), going slightly past 180° and coming back.
Card width = original width × |cos θ|. The face artwork is swapped as it passes 90°.
Perspective: the card is drawn in thin vertical slices whose height varies by up to ±20% × sin θ from one side to the other (far side shorter, near side taller).
During the turn it scales up 8% and lifts 6 px on a sine curve; a dark overlay with opacity 0.34 × |sin θ| shades the face. An elliptical shadow sits on the floor.
use: Use it for two things that are sides of one another: question and answer, before and after.

meaning.en: A band of light crosses a surface
meaning.ru: Полоса света наискосок проходит по поверхности

ask.en: After the logo settles, add one light sweep from top-left to bottom-right, subtle.
ask.ru: По логотипу проходит блик слева направо за 20 кадров.

summary: A band of light crosses the surface of a logo badge at an angle.
spec: One sweep per 2.35 s. The light is drawn only inside a clip of the badge (400 × 112, radius 28, blue gradient).
Light band: a 116 px wide white gradient (opacity 0.72 in the middle, 0 at the edges) plus a thin 12 px band (opacity 0.5) 78 px away, rotated 0.42 rad (about 24°).
It moves from 130 px left of the badge to 130 px right of it (660 px) at 0.45–1.5 s, quadratic ease-in-out.
Sparkle: a four-point star at the top-right corner at 1.38–1.98 s; size 30 × sin(πq) × (1 + 0.2(1 − q)), rotating 0.9 rad.
The badge itself does not move.
use: Use it to give a logo, badge or button a premium finish.

meaning.en: The picture breaks up as if it were malfunctioning
meaning.ru: Срезы сдвигаются, цвета расслаиваются, без вспышек

ask.en: Add a brief glitch to the title: 0.3 s, a mild color split, no flashing.
ask.ru: Глитч на слове на 6 кадров, RGB-расслоение.

summary: Text slices shift sideways, colours split and small bars appear, with no brightness flashing.
spec: White bold text (104 px). It glitches twice per 4.7 s: 0.55–1.25 s (5 steps) and 2.9–3.74 s (6 steps); otherwise it is still.
Each step lasts 0.14 s and shows one fixed disturbance (stepped, not smoothly animated).
Colour split: a coral copy shifted 7–16 px left and 2 px down, a cyan (#22D3EE) copy shifted the same amount right and 2 px up, with the white text on top.
Slice shift: 2–4 horizontal strips (10–35 px tall, y 40–150) are displaced 18–64 px to the left or right.
Three small colour bars (coral, cyan, yellow; 30–120 wide × 5–12 tall) at random positions.
Background brightness never changes (no full-frame flashing). The random values use a fixed seed.
use: Use it for a digital, error or uneasy feel, as an accent on titles and scene changes.

meaning.en: The whole frame shakes when something lands
meaning.ru: Тяжёлый заголовок падает, и весь кадр трясёт от удара

ask.en: Add an impact shake when the headline lands; it should settle within 0.4 s.
ask.ru: Заголовок впечатывается, тряска кадра 8 кадров.

summary: A heavy headline slab drops with a thud and the whole frame shakes from the impact.
spec: One drop per 2.35 s (a yellow slab first, then a coral one). The slab is 250 × 100, radius 18.
Fall: 0.3–0.62 s from above the frame to the floor, cubic ease-in (accelerating). While falling it is stretched 1.12× vertically.
Lands at 0.62 s. The whole frame shakes for 1.1 s: x 15 px × e^(−5t) × sin(2π·5t), y 11 px × e^(−5t) × cos(2π·6.5t), rotation 0.02 rad × e^(−5t) × sin(2π·5t + 0.6).
For 0.3 s after landing the slab squashes vertically by up to 22% and recovers (it widens by the same amount; anchored at its base).
Four background blocks hop up to 24 px, 0.03–0.06 s late, over 0.5 s. Six white lines and six dust puffs spread from the floor and fade within 0.55 s.
Exit: the slab moves 300 px up at 1.85–2.2 s (backIn, s = 1.6).
use: Use it to land an important headline or number with weight and force.

meaning.en: Pivot the camera left or right
meaning.ru: Камера на месте поворачивается влево-вправо

ask.en: Slow pan from left to right across the skyline, camera fixed in place, over 5 seconds.
ask.ru: Медленная панорама слева направо по городу.

summary: The camera stays in place and pivots from left to right; because it is a rotation, near and far layers slide sideways by the same amount.
spec: Camera: position fixed (height 1.5 m); yaw only, -0.32 rad → +0.32 rad (-18° → +18°, about 37° in total)
Timing: rotate from 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: a person (about 1.8 m tall) stands still 8 m ahead and slides right-to-left in frame
No parallax: mountains, buildings, trees and the person all shift by the same angle (focal length 330 px on a 539×208 card)
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
Top-right readout shows the angle in whole degrees (-18° → +18°)
use: To reveal a wide location or to shift attention from one side of the scene to the other.

meaning.en: Pivot the camera up or down
meaning.ru: Камера на месте поворачивается вверх или вниз

ask.en: Slow tilt up from the person's feet to the top of the tower.
ask.ru: Тилт снизу вверх: от человека к вершине башни.

summary: The camera stays in place and pivots upward, from a person at ground level up to the top of a tower.
spec: Camera: position fixed (height 1.4 m); pitch only, -0.06 rad → +0.36 rad (-3° → +21°, about 24° in total)
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: a person stands still 7 m ahead; a 9.5 m tower (antenna tip at 11.8 m) stands 26 m away behind
On screen everything slides downward: the person leaves at the bottom while the tower top and its antenna enter
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
Top-right readout shows the angle in whole degrees (-3° → +21°)
use: To show the height or scale of a building or a person.

meaning.en: Move the camera toward the subject
meaning.ru: Камера сама едет к объекту, ближнее растёт быстрее дальнего

ask.en: Slow dolly in toward her face; move the camera, do not zoom.
ask.ru: Медленный наезд на героя, 8% за весь шот.

summary: The camera itself moves toward the subject; near objects grow and pass quickly while the distant mountains barely change.
spec: Camera: moves forward (in depth) 0 m → 5.8 m; height 1.5 m, direction and focal length (330 px, shown as 24mm) fixed
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: a person stands still 8 m ahead; distance goes 8 m → 2.2 m, so they appear about 3.6× larger
Parallax: a foreground post (1.5 m left, 3.6 m deep) and a rock (1.6 m right, 4.8 m deep) pass out of frame; mountains 120 m+ away stay almost the same size
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
The top-right readout stays at 24mm (the difference from 04 Zoom in)
use: To move in on a person or detail while keeping a sense of depth.

meaning.en: Magnify with the lens (camera stays put)
meaning.ru: Камера стоит, меняется только фокусное — всё увеличивается одинаково

ask.en: The camera stays still; zoom in on the person at the window over 3 seconds.
ask.ru: Зум в деталь на ключевой фразе.

summary: The camera does not move; only the focal length gets longer, so the whole picture enlarges by the same ratio.
spec: Camera: position and direction fixed (height 1.5 m); only the focal length changes, 330 px → 1200 px (shown as 24mm → 87mm, about 3.6×)
Exponential interpolation: f = 330 × (8/2.2)^p, where p is a cubic ease-in-out from 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s)
Subject: a person stands still 8 m ahead; the final size matches 03 Dolly in (about 3.6×)
No parallax: the foreground post and rock, the person, buildings and mountains all scale by the same ratio (overlaps do not change)
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
Top-right readout shows the focal length in mm (24mm → 87mm)
use: To direct attention to one point without moving the camera; it looks flatter and more observational than a dolly in.

meaning.en: Move along with the subject
meaning.ru: Камера едет вбок вместе с объектом

ask.en: Tracking shot from the side, moving along with the walking person at the same speed.
ask.ru: Камера едет рядом с идущим человеком, столбы пролетают на переднем плане.

summary: The camera moves sideways at the same speed as a walking person; the person stays centred while nearer posts sweep past faster.
spec: Camera: moves right at a constant 1.7 m/s (x = -4.0 m → +4.0 m in 4.7 s); height 1.3 m, facing straight ahead; no easing
Subject: a person walks at the same x as the camera (7.5 m away) and stays in the centre of frame; legs and arms swing by sin(u×7)×0.42 rad
Parallax: posts every 1.6 m at 4 m depth sweep left fastest, then trees, then buildings (48 m away); mountains hardly move
Top-right readout shows "→ 1.7m/s"
Repeat: jumps back to the start every 4.7 s (posts and ground grid line up at the seam; background buildings and trees jump)
use: To follow a walking or running subject and keep the sense of movement while showing their action.

meaning.en: Circle around the subject
meaning.ru: Камера движется по кругу вокруг объекта

ask.en: Half orbit around the standing person, keeping them in the center of the frame.
ask.ru: Облёт продукта на 30°, фон уезжает вбок.

summary: The camera travels on a circle around the subject; the person stays centred while the trees and buildings behind sweep sideways.
spec: Camera: travels on a circle of radius 6 m centred on the person (9 m ahead), from -0.95 rad → +0.95 rad (-54° → +54°, about 109° in total)
Direction: always faces the centre (yaw = -angle); height 1.7 m, pitch fixed at -0.07 rad (about 4° down)
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.6 s (3.1 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: the person does not move; a white dot on the face shifts sideways with the angle; a dashed circle of radius 1.3 m marks the ground
Background: 12 trees evenly spaced on a 10 m radius cross behind the person as the camera moves round
Return: hold 3.6–4.2 s, then cross-fade back over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows the angle (-54° → +54°)
use: To show a person or product in three dimensions, or to emphasise an entrance or a key moment.

meaning.en: Lift the camera up
meaning.ru: Камера поднимается и смотрит вниз на героя

ask.en: Crane up from eye level until the whole town comes into view.
ask.ru: Финальный шот — кран вверх над героем.

summary: The camera rises while tilting down until it looks down on the person.
spec: Camera: rises from 1.4 m to 9 m while moving forward 0 m → 1.5 m
Direction: tilts down to keep the person (8 m ahead) in frame; pitch = -0.86 × atan2(height - 1.0, 8 - forward), about -2.5° → -44°
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: the person does not move; they get smaller as the camera rises, the ground grid fills the frame and the horizon leaves at the top
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
Top-right readout shows the height (↑ 1.4m → ↑ 9.0m)
use: To pull away from a person at the end of a scene or to reveal how large the location is.

meaning.en: Subject stays, background warps
meaning.ru: Герой того же размера, а фон наезжает или уезжает

ask.en: Dolly zoom on his face at the moment he realizes: he stays the same size while the background stretches away.
ask.ru: Долли-зум на лице героя в момент осознания.

summary: The camera pulls back while zooming in by the same ratio; the person keeps the same size and only the background closes in.
spec: Camera: distance d to the person (8 m ahead) widens from 3.2 m → 8 m (a 4.8 m pull-back); height 1.3 m
Focal length: f = 330 × d/8 px, i.e. 132 px → 330 px (shown as 10mm → 24mm), keeping distance ÷ focal length constant
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: the person does not move and keeps the same height in frame; blue dashed lines 160 px wide at head (1.8 m) and feet show the size is constant
Background: buildings (48 m away) grow about 2.2× and mountains about 2.4×, closing in behind the person, while the ground in front of the person shrinks
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
use: For a moment of realisation, or to show unease or shock visually.

meaning.en: Shift focus between near and far
meaning.ru: Фокус переходит с переднего плана на задний

ask.en: Rack focus from the cup in the foreground to the person behind it, in 1 second.
ask.ru: Перевод фокуса с цветка на человека за 20 кадров.

summary: The camera does not move; focus shifts from a flower in the foreground to a person behind it, swapping which one is blurred.
spec: Camera: position, direction and focal length all fixed (height 1.1 m); only the blur amounts change
Blur: the foreground flower (0.75 m left, 2 m away) goes 0 px → 7 px; the person and background (person 0.9 m right, 9 m away) go 6 px → 0 px; the ground grid uses 0.6× the background blur
Timing: 1.0 s to 2.6 s (1.6 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Focus marker: blue corner brackets travel in a straight line from the flower to the person, half-width shrinking 46 px → 30 px
Subject: neither the flower nor the person moves
Return: hold 2.6–4.2 s, then cross-fade back over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows focus distance (◎ 2m → ◎ 9m)
use: To move attention from foreground to background (or back) without cutting.

meaning.en: A slight shake, as if the camera were held by hand
meaning.ru: Лёгкая неровная тряска, как будто камеру держат в руках

ask.en: Handheld shot following behind the walking person, with only a slight shake.
ask.ru: Лёгкая ручная тряска на всём ролике, без резких рывков.

summary: Adds a small, irregular shake to the whole frame, as if the camera were held by hand instead of on a tripod.
spec: Camera: position almost fixed; yaw, pitch, roll and height each get a sum of sine waves with different periods (T = 2π×u/4.7)
Yaw (rad) = 0.016·sin(3T) + 0.008·sin(7T+1) + 0.004·sin(13T+2), at most about ±1.6°
Roll (rad) = 0.02·sin(5T+1) + 0.008·sin(11T+3), at most about ±1.6°; height = 1.5 + 0.03·sin(6T) m
Subject: a person stands still 6.5 m ahead; the shake runs continuously with no easing or hold
All multipliers are integers, so it loops seamlessly every 4.7 s; top-right readout shows "HANDHELD"
use: To give a documentary feel or the sense of being present in the scene.

meaning.en: Fast, immersive fly-through
meaning.ru: Быстрый полёт от первого лица с кренами

ask.en: FPV drone shot weaving between the trees and out over the river.
ask.ru: FPV-пролёт сквозь текст с кренами и линиями скорости.

summary: A first-person view flying low and fast between two rows of trees, banking from side to side.
spec: Camera: flies forward at a constant 14 m/s (shown as 50km/h) with no easing; pitch fixed at -0.05 rad
Weave (T = 2π×u/4.7, two swings per 4.7 s): sideways 0.6·sin(2T-0.4) m, height 1.4 + 0.5·sin(2T) m
Bank: roll 0.22·sin(2T+0.6) rad (about ±12.6°), yaw 0.05·sin(2T) rad (about ±2.9°)
No subject. Trees 4.2 m tall stand 3.6 m to each side, every 8 m, the two rows offset by 4 m, and rush toward the camera
Speed lines: 10 radial strokes about 32–76 px long (longer toward the sides) in translucent grey, flowing outward and recycling
No hold and no cross-fade reset (the tree rows shift phase when it restarts every 4.7 s)
use: For speed and immersion, or to fly through a location in one continuous move.

meaning.en: Tilt the frame diagonally
meaning.ru: Камера заваливается — горизонт по диагонали

ask.en: Use a Dutch angle of about 15 degrees for this uneasy scene.
ask.ru: Завал горизонта 12° в напряжённой сцене.

summary: A level camera rolls around its lens axis and holds with the horizon on a diagonal.
spec: Camera: position fixed (height 1.5 m); roll only, 0 → 0.36 rad (about 21°); the whole picture turns around the frame centre
Timing: 0.6 s to 2.2 s (1.6 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: a person stands still 7 m ahead; horizon, buildings and person all tilt by the same angle
Hold: stays tilted from 2.2 s to 4.2 s (time to read the tilted composition itself)
Return: cross-fade back to the level start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
Top-right readout shows the angle (∠ 0° → ∠ 21°)
use: To express unease, tension or the feeling that something is wrong.

meaning.en: Play the action slower
meaning.ru: Действие растянуто во времени

ask.en: Show the moment of the splash in slow motion.
ask.ru: Слоу-мо 0.5× на прыжке.

summary: In front of a fixed camera a person rises and falls slowly through a jump while leaves drift down slowly; the whole action is stretched out.
spec: Camera: completely fixed (height 1.3 m); only the subject moves
Subject: a person 7 m away takes 3.8 s for one jump (0.5 s to 4.3 s); height = 4q(1-q)×1.1 m, a parabola peaking at 1.1 m, with q linear in time
Both arms are raised while airborne; the person stands still for 0.5 s before the jump and 0.4 s after landing
Leaves: 9 leaves fall from 3.4 m to the ground over 4.7 s while rotating, each offset by 1/9 of the cycle
Top-right readout shows "120fps ×0.25" (playback stretched 4×)
No hold and no cross-fade; loops seamlessly every 4.7 s
use: To let viewers study a brief action or expression, or to emphasise an emotional peak.

meaning.en: Change speed mid-shot
meaning.ru: Внутри шота скорость плавно меняется с быстрой на медленную

ask.en: Speed ramp: normal speed, slowing at the top of the jump, then back to normal.
ask.ru: Спид-рамп в переходе: до 45% и обратно, S-кривая.

summary: Within one shot the playback speed changes smoothly from fast to slow; a graph at bottom left shows the speed.
spec: Camera: completely fixed (height 1.3 m); only the playback speed changes
Playback speed: 2.4× → 0.25×; the change takes 0.7 s (1.2 s to 1.9 s) with a quadratic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1))
Subject: a person 8 m away runs from 6 m left toward the right; x = -6 + footage time × 2.0 m; they close in quickly during the fast section
Jump: a parabola while x is between -1.5 m and 2.5 m, peak 0.99 m, arms raised; take-off at about 0.94 s, most of the airtime plays in slow motion, landing at about 3.68 s
Graph: a 120×40 px speed curve at bottom left with a blue dot (radius 5 px) at the current time
Return: stops at 4.2 s, then cross-fades back over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows the rate (×2.4 → ×0.3)
use: To slow down only the key part of an action while keeping the lead-in quick.

meaning.en: Compress hours into seconds
meaning.ru: Часы сжаты в секунды: солнце и тени бегут

ask.en: Time-lapse of the city from dusk to night as the lights come on.
ask.ru: Таймлапс дня за 3 секунды: рассвет → закат.

summary: With a fixed camera, 06:00 to 18:00 is compressed into a few seconds; sun, clouds, people and shadows move in fast forward.
spec: Camera: completely fixed (height 1.6 m, pitch +0.08 rad, about 5° up)
Timing: 12 hours pass in 3.7 s (0.4 s to 4.1 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Sun: travels left to right along an arc, angle a = -1.25 rad → +1.25 rad; position (sin a×120, cos a×60 - 8) m at 170 m depth
Three clouds drift 140 m to the right in total, wrapping every 80 m; seven small figures each cross an 18 m width 6 times (odd and even ones in opposite directions)
Building shadows fall away from the sun and swing as it moves (translucent grey)
Return: cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s; the top-right clock runs 06:00 → 18:00 in 10-minute steps
use: To show a long stretch of time, or how a city, sky or task changes, in a short clip.

meaning.en: Pause the action for a beat
meaning.ru: Картинка замирает в пике и потом продолжается

ask.en: Freeze frame at the moment she turns around; hold for 1 second and show her name.
ask.ru: Стоп-кадр в высшей точке прыжка, подпись с именем.

summary: The picture stops at the moment a jumping person reaches the top, then resumes from the same frame 1.4 s later.
spec: Camera: completely fixed (height 1.3 m); what stops is the footage time
Freeze: stops at 1.6 s and resumes at 3.0 s (1.4 s); footage time runs normally for 0–1.6 s, stays at 1.6 s while frozen, then continues as u-1.4
Subject: the jump of a person 7 m away is a parabola over footage time 0.6–2.6 s, peak 1.1 m; the freeze lands exactly on the peak (50% through)
Nine falling leaves also stop during the freeze; they fall 1.5× as fast as in 13 Slow motion
Freeze markers: a 5 px blue border and a pause icon at bottom centre (two blue bars on a 68×40 px white rounded box), fading in and out over 0.12 s
Top-right readout shows "FREEZE" only while frozen; no cross-fade reset
use: To emphasise a decisive moment, or to pause so a name or caption can be placed over the frame.

meaning.en: Same framing, skip ahead in time
meaning.ru: Ракурс тот же, а время внутри сцены перескакивает

ask.en: Use jump cuts from the same framing to move quickly through the preparation.
ask.ru: Вырезать паузы джамп-катами, на каждом лёгкий панч-ин.

summary: Camera position and framing stay the same while the person's position and the clock jump; time is skipped inside one scene.
spec: Join: a straight cut with no effect (0 frames); 5 shots of 0.94 s each (4.7 s ÷ 5)
Camera: identical position and framing in every shot (height 1.4 m, facing forward); the background does not move by a pixel
What changes: the person (7 m away) jumps in sideways position, -2.2 m → 1.4 m → -0.4 m → 2.4 m → 0.6 m; in shots 2 and 4 both arms are raised
Within each shot the person is still (the jump is shown only by the difference in position and pose)
Top-right clock: 10:02 → 10:17 → 10:41 → 11:06 → 11:30, showing that time was skipped in the same place
Shot 5 cuts straight back to shot 1
use: To tighten pauses in talk or work and raise the pace, or to show time passing quickly.

meaning.en: Cut on a matching shape or motion
meaning.ru: Склейка по совпадающей форме: мяч становится солнцем

ask.en: Match cut from the round coffee cup to a full moon in the same position.
ask.ru: Матч-кат: глаз → луна в той же точке кадра.

summary: A thrown ball becomes, in the next shot, a sun at the same position and size; two different scenes are joined on a matching shape.
spec: Join: a straight cut at 2.3 s (0 frames); the blue circle has the same position (120 px right, 46 px above centre) and radius 17 px on both sides
Outgoing shot (0–2.3 s): fixed camera (height 1.4 m); a person (1.2 m left, 7 m away) throws a ball from 0.5 s, cubic ease-out (about cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1))
Ball: travels from above the person's head (2.3 m high) to the match point; radius 5 px → 17 px, on an arc bulging up to 30 px
Incoming shot (2.3–4.7 s): a different place (no buildings, height 1.2 m); the blue circle in the same spot is now the sun and sinks 14 px over 2.4 s
Marker: a blue dashed circle of radius 26 px fades in and out within 0.7 s either side of the cut
Top-right readout shows "SHOT 1" → "SHOT 2"; at 4.7 s it cuts straight back to SHOT 1
use: To link two scenes far apart in time or place through a shared shape or motion.

meaning.en: Fast pan blur into the next shot
meaning.ru: Резкий рывок камеры вбок, сцена меняется внутри смаза

ask.en: Whip pan to the right and land in the next location.
ask.ru: Вип-пан между сценами, 8 кадров, свуш на склейке.

summary: The camera swings sideways very fast and the next scene is swapped in during the streaked blur.
spec: Join: 0.8 s, from 1.7 s to 2.5 s; in the first 0.4 s the outgoing shot swings away, in the last 0.4 s the incoming shot swings in and settles
First half: outgoing yaw 0 → +0.45 rad (about 26°), quadratic ease-in-out; second half: incoming yaw -0.45 rad → 0, same easing
Swap: a straight replacement at the 50% point, hidden because the blur is at its strongest
Blur: 9 renders spread over ±1.6 frames (at 30 fps) are averaged
Camera: height 1.4 m, fixed except during the swing; the subjects (a person in A, a car and city in B) do not move
Alternates A→B and B→A every 4.7 s (9.4 s for the round trip); top-right readout shows "A → B" / "B → A"
use: To change location or topic while keeping the energy up.

meaning.en: Blend one shot into the next
meaning.ru: Новая картинка проявляется поверх старой

ask.en: Cross dissolve from the room in the morning to the same room at night, 1 second.
ask.ru: Мягкое растворение 12 кадров между сценами.

summary: The next picture is laid over the current one and its opacity rises until it takes over; both show through each other midway.
spec: Join: 1.5 s, from 1.5 s to 3.0 s; the incoming picture's opacity goes 0 → 100%
Easing: quadratic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1)); 50% at 2.25 s
The outgoing picture stays fully opaque underneath and the incoming one is drawn on top (the outgoing one is not faded out first)
Camera: fixed in both pictures (A at height 1.4 m; B at height 1.6 m, pitch +0.1 rad); the subjects do not move either
Only the outgoing picture shows for 0–1.5 s, only the incoming one for 3.0–4.7 s
Alternates A→B and B→A every 4.7 s (9.4 s for the round trip); top-right readout shows "A → B" / "B → A"
use: To convey a gentle passage of time or change of place, or to move into a memory.

meaning.en: A moving edge replaces the shot
meaning.ru: Граница проходит по кадру и заменяет картинку

ask.en: Wipe from left to right into the next scene.
ask.ru: Шторка слева направо с акцентной кромкой.

summary: A vertical edge moves from left to right and the next picture replaces the current one behind it.
spec: Join: 1.1 s, from 1.7 s to 2.8 s; the edge travels from just outside the left side (x = -4 px) to just outside the right side (x = 543 px)
Easing: cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
The incoming picture shows left of the edge and the outgoing one right of it; neither picture moves (a reveal by clipping, not a push)
Edge: a 4 px blue vertical line, visible only while it is moving
Camera: fixed in both pictures; the subjects do not move either
Alternates A→B and B→A every 4.7 s (9.4 s for the round trip); top-right readout shows "A → B" / "B → A"
use: To mark a clear change of scene or topic, or to switch between the two sides of a comparison.

meaning.en: Abrupt cut to a contrasting scene
meaning.ru: Без предупреждения из тишины — в громкое

ask.en: Smash cut from the quiet bedroom to a noisy intersection.
ask.ru: Тишина и спящий герой — смэш-кат на дроп со вспышкой.

summary: A quiet scene of a person asleep cuts with no warning straight to an intense one; the volume meter jumps at the same moment.
spec: Join: a straight cut at 2.4 s (0 frames); no transition effect, the contrast does the work
Outgoing shot (0–2.4 s): fixed camera (height 1.2 m, focal length 330 px); a person lying down 7 m away, three "z" letters float up and fade; volume meter at about 0–1 of 8 bars (0.08±0.04)
Incoming shot (2.4–4.2 s): focal length 2.6× (858 px) for a tight framing, rolled -0.12 rad (about -7°); the person has both arms raised, with 18 radial blue lines
Shake in the incoming shot: roll ±0.03 rad (about 6 cycles per second) and yaw ±0.006 rad (about 8 per second); volume meter at 0.85±0.15, nearly full
Return: cross-fade back to the quiet shot over the last 0.5 s (quadratic ease-in-out)
Top-right readout shows "♪ 静か" (quiet) → "♪ 大音量" (loud)
use: For comedy or shock, showing in an instant the gap between calm and chaos or between expectation and reality.

meaning.en: Next scene's audio starts first
meaning.ru: Звук следующей сцены начинается раньше картинки

ask.en: J-cut: let the sound of waves from the next scene start before cutting to the sea.
ask.ru: J-кат: голос следующего спикера за 10 кадров до склейки.

summary: The next scene's audio starts before the picture changes; the picture is shown on top with video and audio timelines below.
spec: Join: the picture is a straight cut; only the audio switches to the next scene (B) before the picture does. The offset is 20% of the timeline (0.72 s)
Playhead: moves left to right at constant speed over 3.6 s (0.4 s to 4.0 s); audio switches at 35% (about 1.66 s), picture at 55% (about 2.38 s)
In the offset section (35–55%) the picture is still A while the audio is already B; the section is marked with a pale blue band and two blue dashed lines
Layout: the top 134 px is the picture (fixed camera, subjects do not move); the bottom 74 px holds two timeline rows, video and audio (A grey, B pale blue, waveform on the audio row)
Labels: "映像A / 映像B" (video A / B) at bottom left of the picture; the audio now playing at bottom right ("♪ Aの音" grey → "♪ Bの音" blue)
Return: cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
use: To build anticipation for the next scene, or to make a change of scene or speaker feel natural.

meaning.en: Previous scene's audio carries over
meaning.ru: Звук прошлой сцены продолжается после смены картинки

ask.en: L-cut: keep her voice going while cutting to the listener's face.
ask.ru: L-кат: фраза договаривается уже на следующем кадре.

summary: The previous scene's audio carries on for a while after the picture has changed; the picture is shown on top with video and audio timelines below.
spec: Join: the picture is a straight cut; only the audio switches to the next scene (B) after the picture does. The offset is 20% of the timeline (0.72 s)
Playhead: moves left to right at constant speed over 3.6 s (0.4 s to 4.0 s); picture switches at 55% (about 2.38 s), audio at 75% (about 3.10 s)
In the offset section (55–75%) the picture is already B while the audio is still A; the section is marked with a pale blue band and two blue dashed lines
Layout: the top 134 px is the picture (fixed camera, subjects do not move); the bottom 74 px holds two timeline rows, video and audio (A grey, B pale blue, waveform on the audio row)
Labels: "映像A / 映像B" (video A / B) at bottom left of the picture; the audio now playing at bottom right ("♪ Aの音" grey → "♪ Bの音" blue)
Return: cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
use: To keep a speaker's voice running while showing the listener's reaction or related footage.

meaning.en: A window opens in the middle while the page behind dims
meaning.ru: Фон затемняется, по центру появляется окно

ask.en: When the delete button is pressed, show a confirmation in a modal dialog. Dim the page about 40% and fade it in over 0.3 s with a slight scale-up.
ask.ru: Мок интерфейса: клик — модалка с лёгким масштабом.

summary: Clicking "Open" dims the whole page and a small window scales up slightly into the centre; clicking × closes it.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. The cursor reaches the "Open" button (120×36, lower left) at 0.95 s and clicks at 1.0 s.
Open amount a: 0→1 over 1.0–1.32 s with easeOutCubic. A full-card scrim rgba(18,20,28) at opacity 0.42·a.
Window: white 280×140, radius 12, centred at (271, 97), shadow blur 24, offset y 8, alpha 0.25. Scale 0.9 + 0.1·a, opacity a.
Inside: a bold title bar, two text lines, a blue 88×30 button at lower right and × at top right.
Close: the cursor moves to × by 3.0 s and clicks at 3.3 s; a is multiplied by (1 − easeInOutCubic over 3.3–3.58 s).
use: Use it when the user must stop and deal with one thing, such as a confirmation or a short form.

meaning.en: A menu panel slides in from the side of the screen
meaning.ru: Панель выезжает сбоку по клику

ask.en: Open a drawer from the left when the menu button is pressed: 40% of the screen wide, sliding in over 0.4 s, with the page slightly dimmed.
ask.ru: Меню-дровер выезжает слева по клику курсора.

summary: Clicking "Menu" slides a tall panel in from the left; clicking outside slides it back.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. The cursor clicks the "Menu" button (110×34, top left) at 1.0 s.
Open amount a: 0→1 over 1.0–1.38 s with easeOutCubic. Full-card scrim rgba(18,20,28) at opacity 0.36·a.
Panel: white, 210 wide, full card height, x = −210 + 210·a so it slides in from the left edge. Shadow blur 22, alpha 0.25.
Inside: an avatar (radius 14) and name at the top, then four menu rows 32 px apart; the first row is selected with a light-blue band.
Close: the cursor clicks outside at (420, 120) at 3.3 s; a is multiplied by (1 − easeInOutCubic over 3.3–3.65 s) and the panel slides back.
use: Use it to keep navigation or filters off screen until needed, especially on mobile.

meaning.en: A panel slides up from the bottom of the screen
meaning.ru: Панель поднимается снизу экрана

ask.en: Show the details in a bottom sheet when "View details" is tapped: 40% of the screen tall, rising over 0.4 s, closing when dragged down.
ask.ru: В мокапе телефона по тапу снизу выезжает шторка с деталями.

summary: A finger taps "View details" and a panel rises from the bottom; dragging its handle down closes it.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A finger (semi-transparent circle, radius 17, white rim) taps the "View details" pill (170×36, bottom centre) at 1.0 s.
Open amount: 0→1 over 1.05–1.45 s with easeOutCubic. Full-card scrim rgba(18,20,28) at opacity 0.36·a.
Sheet: white, 136 tall, top corners radius 18, top edge at y = 191 − 136·a. Shadow blur 22, offset y −4. A 52×6 grab handle at top centre.
Inside: a bold title bar and two rows with 26×26 icons.
Close: the finger lands on the handle (271, 68) at 2.75 s and drags down over 3.0–3.6 s; a is multiplied by (1 − easeInOutCubic over 3.0–3.6 s), so the sheet follows the finger off the bottom.
use: Use it on mobile to show details or choices while keeping the current screen in view.

meaning.en: Click a heading to show or hide its content
meaning.ru: Заголовок раскрывает содержимое и сдвигает строки ниже

ask.en: Make the FAQ an accordion: the clicked item opens over 0.35 s and its arrow turns 180°.
ask.ru: FAQ-аккордеон: раскрывается первый пункт.

summary: Clicking the first of three headings opens its content and pushes the rows below down; clicking again closes it.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. Three headings (494 wide, 34 tall, radius 8, gap 6) with a down chevron at the right.
The cursor reaches the first heading at 0.95 s and clicks at 1.0 s and 3.3 s.
Open amount ex: 0→1 over 1.0–1.35 s with easeInOutCubic, then 1→0 over 3.3–3.62 s.
The first row grows from 34 to 92 tall (+58·ex) and pushes the rows below down; its two content lines are clipped to the row and fade in with opacity ex.
While open, the chevron rotates 180°·ex, the border turns light blue and the heading blue.
use: Use it for FAQs or long details where people scan the headings and open only what they need.

meaning.en: Click a field to drop a list of options below it
meaning.ru: Клик по полю открывает варианты

ask.en: Make the prefecture field a dropdown: open the options below it in 0.25 s and close it with the value filled in once one is picked.
ask.ru: Дропдаун: выбираем «Москва», список закрывается.

summary: Clicking the field opens four options below it; picking "Nagoya" closes the list and fills the field.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A 260×38 field (radius 8) shows a placeholder and a chevron; the cursor clicks it at 1.0 s.
Open amount: 0→1 over 1.0–1.25 s with easeOutCubic. The list (white 260×112, shadow blur 18) fades in while dropping 6 px. The chevron turns 180° and the field border becomes 2 px blue.
Four options 26 px apart (Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, Fukuoka in Japanese). As the cursor moves down, Osaka is highlighted light blue from 1.55 s and Nagoya from 1.95 s.
Click on Nagoya at 2.3 s: the list closes over 2.3–2.45 s (1 − easeInOutCubic); the placeholder fades out over 2.2–2.3 s and "Nagoya" fades in over 2.32–2.42 s.
Reset: Nagoya fades out over 3.9–4.08 s, then the placeholder returns over 4.1–4.3 s, so the two texts never overlap.
use: Use it in a form when people pick one value from a fixed list.

meaning.en: Hover over something to show a short label
meaning.ru: Короткая подсказка в пузыре при наведении

ask.en: Add a tooltip to the "?" icon: show the note above it 0.2 s after hover, and hide it when the cursor leaves.
ask.ru: Наводим на «?» — тёмный тултип сверху.

summary: Hovering over a "?" icon shows a short note in a dark bubble above it; it disappears when the cursor leaves.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A "?" icon (blue ring, radius 13) at (196, 121) next to a label.
The cursor only hovers, no click: it arrives on "?" at 1.05 s, stays until 3.15 s and leaves the card by 4.1 s.
Show amount a: 0→1 over 1.15–1.35 s with easeOutCubic; opacity a, rising 6 px into place.
Bubble: #26282c, 184×36, radius 8, top at y 64, with a 16-wide, 8-tall triangle pointing down at the icon; white 15 px text.
Hide: linear 1→0 over 3.25–3.45 s.
use: Use it to add a one-line hint to an icon or abbreviation without taking space on the page.

meaning.en: Click a button to open a small panel pointing at it
meaning.ru: Небольшая панель со стрелкой у кнопки

ask.en: Attach a popover to the "Details" button: clicking opens a small panel to its right over 0.3 s, and OK closes it.
ask.ru: Поповер справа от кнопки «Детали».

summary: Clicking "Details" opens a small white panel to its right with a pointer at the button; clicking OK inside closes it.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. An outlined blue "Details" button (108×36) at (24, 112); the cursor clicks it at 1.0 s.
Show amount a: 0→1 over 1.0–1.28 s with easeOutCubic; opacity a, sliding 6 px in from the right.
Panel: white 300×120, radius 10, at (156, 62), 1 px border, shadow blur 22, offset y 6. A 10-wide triangle on its left edge (y 122–138) points at the button.
Inside: a bold title bar, two text lines, an outlined 70×26 button and a blue 72×26 OK button.
Close: the cursor moves to OK (402, 157) by 3.0 s and clicks at 3.3 s; a is multiplied by (1 − easeInOutCubic over 3.3–3.5 s).
use: Use it for a short setting or confirmation that belongs right next to the button that opened it.

meaning.en: A short message appears in a corner and goes away on its own
meaning.ru: Короткое уведомление выезжает в углу и уходит

ask.en: After saving, show "Saved" as a toast at the bottom right: slide it in from the right in 0.35 s and dismiss it automatically after 2 s.
ask.ru: После «Сохранить» — тост в правом нижнем углу с полоской таймера.

summary: Clicking "Save" slides a dark notice into the bottom-right corner; when its time bar runs out it slides away.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. The cursor clicks the blue "Save" button (110×36, bottom left) at 1.0 s and leaves to the bottom left.
Toast: #26282c, 214×52, radius 10, 18 px from the right and 16 px from the bottom; slides in 240 px from the right over 1.05–1.4 s with easeOutCubic.
Inside: a white check in a blue circle and white 15 px text "Saved".
A time-left line along the bottom (3 px tall) shrinks linearly from 194 px to 0 over 1.4–3.2 s.
Exit: slides 240 px out to the right over 3.2–3.55 s with easeInOutCubic.
use: Use it to confirm a result such as a save or send without interrupting the user.

meaning.en: Click a label to switch which panel is shown
meaning.ru: Подчёркивание переезжает, содержимое меняется

ask.en: Put three tabs at the top of the pricing page. On click, slide the underline over 0.25 s and cross-fade the content in 0.2 s.
ask.ru: Переключаем вкладки, синяя линия скользит под активной.

summary: Clicking the tabs "Overview, Pricing, Reviews" in turn slides a blue underline across and swaps the content below.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. Three tabs at x 24, 114, 204, widths 70, 70, 100; a 2 px divider at y 50 and a 4 px blue underline.
The cursor clicks the second tab at 1.0 s, the third at 2.2 s and the first at 3.4 s.
Underline: position and width move to the new tab over 0.25 s from each click with easeInOutCubic (from the third back to the first it passes through the middle).
Labels: selected is blue and bold, others grey; the switch happens at 1.1, 2.3 and 3.5 s.
Content: the old panel fades out linearly in 0.2 s; 0.1 s later the new one fades in over 0.2 s while rising 8 px.
use: Use it to show several related views in the same space and let people switch between them.

meaning.en: Slides that move sideways to show one item at a time
meaning.ru: Ряд картинок сдвигается на шаг

ask.en: Turn the top images into a carousel: the right arrow moves one slide in 0.4 s, with position dots below.
ask.ru: Карусель из трёх скриншотов, листается раз в секунду.

summary: Each click on the right arrow slides a row of three different images one step to the left, and the dot below moves.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. Slides 330×138, radius 8, centred with an 18 px gap; the neighbours peek in at the edges.
White round buttons (radius 18, shadow blur 10) with chevrons at left and right; three dots below (current one blue 16×8, others 8×8).
The cursor clicks the right arrow (514, 88) at 1.0, 2.1 and 3.2 s.
Each click moves the row 348 px left (one slide plus gap) over 0.4 s with easeInOutCubic.
The three pictures (landscape, three circles, bar chart) repeat, so after three moves the first is back.
use: Use it to show several images or featured items in limited space, one at a time.

meaning.en: Flip a setting on or off
meaning.ru: Переключатель вкл/выкл

ask.en: Put a toggle switch on each notification setting: the knob slides in 0.2 s and the track turns blue when on.
ask.ru: Тумблер «Тёмная тема» включается с пружинкой.

summary: The switches on the first two of three setting rows are turned on in turn, then off again.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. Three setting rows 60 px apart with dividers. At x 450 a 64×34 track (radius 17) and a white knob (radius 13, shadow).
Clicks: row 1 on at 1.0 s, row 2 on at 1.8 s, row 1 off at 3.0 s, row 2 off at 3.6 s. Row 3 stays off.
Each switch takes 0.2 s with easeOutCubic; the knob slides 30 px (17 → 47).
The track colour blends from grey #d9d7d5 to blue #1f5ae8 with the switch progress.
use: Use it for settings that take effect immediately and have only two states.

name.ja: セグメントコントロール

meaning.en: A row of joined buttons that switches the view
meaning.ru: Подсветка переезжает между День/Неделя/Месяц

ask.en: Put a Day / Week / Month segmented control above the chart: the selected background slides over 0.25 s and the chart changes with it.
ask.ru: Переключаем День → Месяц, график под ним перестраивается.

summary: Clicking Day, Week or Month slides a blue highlight across and the bar chart below changes height.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A grey 300×40 base (radius 10) at (121, 12), split into three 100-wide segments: Day, Week, Month (in Japanese).
Selection: blue 92×32, radius 8, shadow blur 6; the selected label is white.
The cursor clicks Week at 1.0 s, Month at 2.1 s and Day at 3.3 s; the selection slides over 0.25 s each with easeInOutCubic.
Chart below: seven bars 34 wide, 58 px apart (the sixth is blue). Heights move between three data sets (about 30–85, 40–100, 60–115) together with the selection, eased the same way.
use: Use it to switch between two to four views of the same content, such as day, week and month.

meaning.en: Small pills you click to add or remove a filter
meaning.ru: Тэги-фильтры включаются, лишние карточки гаснут

ask.en: Add filter chips above the list: a clicked chip gets a check mark and turns blue, and the list filters within 0.15 s.
ask.ru: Включаем чипсы «Новое» и «Бесплатно», лишнее гаснет.

summary: Clicking the "New" and "Free" chips adds a check mark and turns them blue, and cards that do not match fade out.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. Four chips ("All, New, Popular, Free" in Japanese): 34 tall, radius 17, width = text + 32, 10 px apart from the left.
Clicks: New on at 0.95 s, Free on at 1.75 s, New off at 3.0 s, Free off at 3.6 s.
Each change takes 0.15 s with easeOutCubic: the chip widens 18 px to make room for a check mark; fill light blue, border and text blue.
List below: four cards (242×54, two columns, two rows); cards that do not match drop from opacity 1 to 0.12.
use: Use it to let people narrow a list or search results by combining a few quick filters.

meaning.en: Two handles on one track pick a minimum and a maximum
meaning.ru: Две ручки сужают диапазон

ask.en: Make the price filter a range slider with two handles, showing each value in a bubble while it is dragged.
ask.ru: Сужаем цену слайдером с двумя ручками.

summary: On a price slider, the left handle is dragged right and the right handle left to narrow the range, then both go back.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. Track: x 54–488, 8 tall, at y 120; the part between the two handles is blue. Range ¥0–¥10,000.
Handles: white, radius 13, 3 px blue rim; while dragged, radius 15 with a light-blue halo of radius 24.
Low handle: 0.1 → 0.3 (¥1,000 → ¥3,000) over 1.0–1.6 s, back over 3.55–3.9 s. High handle: 1.0 → 0.8 (¥10,000 → ¥8,000) over 2.1–2.6 s, back over 2.95–3.3 s. All easeInOutCubic.
A value bubble (28 tall) above each handle, blue with white text while dragged. The range "¥1,000 – ¥10,000" is shown in blue at top right, updated in ¥100 steps.
The cursor sits on the handle it drags (presses at 1.0, 2.1, 2.95 and 3.55 s).
use: Use it to filter by a range, such as price, date or size, with a minimum and a maximum.

meaning.en: Plus and minus buttons that change a number by one
meaning.ru: Число меняется по нажатию, с лёгким попом

ask.en: Make the quantity field a stepper: + and − change it by one, and the number pops slightly for 0.25 s on each press.
ask.ru: Жмём + три раза, число подпрыгивает.

summary: Pressing + three times raises the number from 1 to 4, and pressing − three times brings it back to 1; the number pops on each press.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A 200×60 box (radius 12) at (171, 52): "−" in the left 60 px, a blue "+" in the right 60 px, and a bold 30 px number in the middle.
The pressed segment is tinted light blue from 0.05 s before to 0.15 s after each click.
Number: on each press its scale goes linearly from 1.18 back to 1 over 0.25 s, and it is blue meanwhile.
use: Use it for small whole numbers changed one at a time, such as quantity or number of guests.

meaning.en: Numbered buttons that move between pages
meaning.ru: Кружок активной страницы переезжает, список меняется

ask.en: Add pagination under the search results: the current page is a blue circle that moves in 0.2 s on click, and the list is replaced.
ask.ru: Листаем страницы 1 → 2 → 3.

summary: Clicking 2 and then 3 in the page numbers moves the blue circle and swaps the list above; finally it goes back to 1.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. "‹ 1 2 3 4 5 ›" centred, each 36 in diameter with 8 px gaps, at y 160. A blue circle (radius 18) marks the current page, with white text.
The cursor clicks 2 at 1.0 s, 3 at 2.1 s and 1 at 3.3 s.
The blue circle moves 44 px per page over 0.2 s each with easeInOutCubic (88 px at once from 3 back to 1).
The three-row list above dips in opacity 1 → 0 → 1 within 0.2 s either side of 1.05, 2.15 and 3.35 s, and its content changes at the dip.
use: Use it to split a long list, such as search results or articles, into numbered pages.

name.ja: ハンバーガーメニュー

meaning.en: A three-line icon that opens the menu
meaning.ru: Три полоски превращаются в крестик, меню выпадает

ask.en: Put a hamburger menu at the right of the mobile header: on tap, morph the three lines into × in 0.3 s and drop the menu down from the top.
ask.ru: Бургер превращается в ×, меню падает сверху.

summary: Clicking the three-line icon at the header's right turns it into ×, and a menu drops down from under the header; clicking again closes it.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A white 44-tall header; three lines (24 long, 3 thick, 8 px apart) at (500, 22) on the right.
The cursor clicks at 1.0 s and 3.3 s. Open amount a: 0→1 over 1.0–1.3 s, 1→0 over 3.3–3.6 s, easeInOutCubic.
Lines to ×: the top and bottom lines move 8 px to the centre and rotate ±45°; the middle line fades with opacity 1 − a. Blue while open.
Menu: white, 140 tall, top at y = 44 − 140 + 140·a so it drops from under the header (clipped below the header), shadow blur 16, four items, the first blue.
use: Use it on narrow screens to tuck the main navigation behind one button.

meaning.en: A trail of links showing where the page sits in the site
meaning.ru: Путь по разделам, клик поднимает на уровень выше

ask.en: Add breadcrumbs above the article: "Home › Courses › Web design", with the current page in bold and not linked.
ask.ru: Клик по «Курсы» в крошках — возврат к списку.

summary: Clicking "Courses" in the breadcrumbs goes up to the list page; clicking a card there returns to the detail page.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. At the top "Home › Courses › Web design" (in Japanese, 17 px): links blue, current page black and bold; a divider at y 46.
The cursor hovers "Courses" (underline 0.9–1.2 s) and clicks at 1.0 s.
Up amount: 0→1 over 1.0–1.25 s with easeInOutCubic. "› Web design" fades out and "Courses" becomes the current page (black, bold).
Content cross-fades from a detail page (title and text) to a list of three cards (158×118, with a landscape picture).
Back: the cursor moves onto the first card (blue outline 2.45–2.8 s) and clicks at 2.7 s; the detail page returns over 2.7–2.95 s.
use: Use it on sites with deep hierarchies to show where the page is and give a way back up.

meaning.en: A wide panel of grouped links that opens from the main menu
meaning.ru: Широкая панель с колонками ссылок при наведении

ask.en: Give "Products" in the header a mega menu: on hover, drop a full-width panel in 0.25 s with three columns of links and an image.
ask.ru: Наводим на «Продукты» — выпадает мега-меню.

summary: Hovering over "Products" in the header drops a full-width panel with three columns of links and an image; it closes when the cursor leaves.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A 42-tall header with "Products, Pricing, Support" (in Japanese, 16 px, each with a down chevron).
The cursor only hovers: it reaches "Products" at 1.0 s. Open amount a: 0→1 over 1.05–1.3 s with easeOutCubic; "Products" turns blue with an underline.
Panel: white, full width, 146 tall, dropping 12 px into place under the header while fading in with a. Shadow blur 18, offset y 8.

Inside: three columns 130 px apart (a blue heading and three links each) and a 104×112 picture at the right. The cursor moves down and the second link of the second column is highlighted light blue from 1.75 to 2.9 s.
Close: the cursor leaves the panel from 2.9 s; it fades over 3.15–3.4 s (1 − easeInOutCubic).
use: Use it on sites with many products or sections so visitors can see the whole range at once.

name.ja: ステップインジケーター

meaning.en: Shows which step of a process you are on
meaning.ru: Кружки шагов превращаются в галочки, линия растёт

ask.en: Add a step indicator above the sign-up form with four steps: Details, Review, Payment, Done; completed steps show a check.
ask.ru: Четыре шага: каждый «Далее» ставит галочку.

summary: Each click on "Next" turns the next of four step circles into a check and extends the blue line to the following step.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. Four steps ("Details, Review, Payment, Done" in Japanese) at x 80, 207, 334, 461, y 35; circles of radius 17 joined by a 4 px grey line.
The cursor clicks "Next" (110×38, bottom right) at 0.9, 1.7 and 2.5 s.
On each click the current step becomes a blue circle with a white check and the next becomes the current one (blue circle, white number). Steps not reached are white with a grey rim.
The blue line grows 127 px per click over 0.3 s with easeInOutCubic; after the third click all four are checked.
Reset: the indicator fades out over 3.75–4.05 s and fades back in at step 1 over 4.05–4.3 s.
use: Use it in multi-step flows such as sign-up or checkout to show progress and what is left.

meaning.en: Grey shapes stand in for content while it loads
meaning.ru: Серые заглушки с бегущим бликом, пока грузится

ask.en: While the list loads, show a skeleton screen: grey blocks in the shape of the content, with a shine sweeping left to right every 0.9 s.
ask.ru: Перед появлением ленты — скелетон с бликом.

summary: Clicking reload turns the list into grey blocks of the same shape with a sweeping shine; the content returns when loading ends.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A two-row list (a 96×56 picture and three text lines each). The cursor clicks the reload icon at top right at 1.0 s.
Over 1.05–1.2 s (linear) the content switches to grey #e9e7e5 rounded blocks of the same size and position.
Shine: a white band 160 wide (transparent at the edges, opacity 0.75 in the middle) sweeps from x −200 to x 742 every 0.9 s, drawn only over the blocks.
The content returns over 3.0–3.3 s (linear).
use: Use it for lists or cards that take a moment to load, so the layout is visible while people wait.

meaning.en: A spinning circle that means "please wait"
meaning.ru: Крутящаяся дуга, потом галочка

ask.en: While sending, show a spinner over the form, turning a little over once per second, then replace it with a blue check when done.
ask.ru: Спиннер на «Отправить», затем галочка и исчезновение.

summary: Clicking "Send" washes the card white and a blue arc spins in the middle; when finished it changes to a check and fades.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. The cursor clicks "Send" (120×40, bottom centre) at 1.0 s.
Over 1.05–1.2 s (linear) a white scrim (opacity 0.78) and the spinner fade in over the whole card.
Spinner at (271, 92): a pale ring, radius 26, 6 thick, with a blue 243° (1.35π) arc on top (round caps), turning 1.3 times per second (468°/s).
Over 2.95–3.05 s the spinner fades; over 2.95–3.2 s a blue circle (radius 28) with a white check scales 0.7 → 1 (easeOutCubic).
Everything fades out linearly over 3.75–4.0 s.
use: Use it for short waits of unknown length, such as sending or saving.

meaning.en: A small dot with a number showing a count
meaning.ru: Точка-счётчик уведомлений растёт 1, 2, 3

ask.en: Add a badge to the bell in the header to show the unread count: it pops for 0.3 s each time the count goes up and disappears when opened.
ask.ru: На колокольчике бейдж считает 1 → 3 с попом.

summary: Each time a notification arrives, the blue dot on the bell in the header counts up 1, 2, 3; clicking the bell clears it.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A 54-tall header with a line-drawn bell at (482, 27) on the right.
Badge: a blue circle of radius 12 at the bell's top right (+12, −12), 2.5 px white rim, white 14 px number.
Notifications arrive at 0.7, 1.3 and 1.9 s: the count goes 1 → 2 → 3. The first scales in over 0.7–0.9 s with easeOutCubic.
Each arrival pops the scale from 1.3 back to 1 over 0.3 s and sends out a ripple ring (radius 12 → 28, opacity 0.5 → 0) over 0.5 s.
The cursor reaches the bell at 2.95 s and clicks at 3.0 s; the badge shrinks to 0 over 3.0–3.25 s with easeInOutCubic.
use: Use it to call attention to a count, such as unread messages or items in a cart.

meaning.en: The screen shown when there is nothing to list yet
meaning.ru: Иллюстрация, «Пока пусто» и кнопка действия

ask.en: When the list is empty, show an empty state: a line icon, "Nothing here yet" and an add button, fading in over 0.35 s.
ask.ru: Удаляем всё — появляется пустое состояние с кнопкой «Добавить».

summary: Deleting the two list rows with their trash icons brings up an empty-box drawing, "Nothing here yet" and an "Add" button.
spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A two-row list (494×48, radius 8, a trash icon at the right).
The cursor clicks the trash icons at 0.95 s and 1.65 s. Each row slides 60 px left while fading out over 0.3 s (easeInOutCubic); the second row moves up 58 px into the first slot.
Over 1.95–2.3 s (linear) the empty state fades in while rising 8 px: a blue line drawing of an inbox tray, "Nothing here yet" (16 px, in Japanese) and a blue "Add" button (112×34).
The cursor clicks "Add" at 3.3 s; the empty state fades over 3.25–3.45 s and the two rows come back from the left over 3.35–3.7 s with easeOutCubic.
use: Use it for first-use screens or no-results pages to tell people what to do next.

name.ja: パララックススクロール

meaning.en: On scroll, background layers move slower than the content
meaning.ru: При прокрутке фоновые слои едут медленнее текста

ask.en: Make the hero background a parallax scroll: move it at 0.3× the scroll distance.
ask.ru: Скролл лендинга с параллаксом гор за заголовком.

summary: As the page scrolls down, the headline moves up normally while the sky and sun, far hills and near hills move more slowly.
spec: A browser window with a 511 × 168 viewport. Scroll: 0→120 px at 0.3–1.9 s, 120→0 at 2.9–4.3 s (cubic ease-in-out).
Each layer moves by scroll × factor: sky and sun 0.15, far hills 0.4, near hills 0.7.
Headline (28 px), button and the next section move at 1.0 (normal scrolling).
The next section (white) starts at the bottom of the hero (168 px) and slides over the slower background.
The scrollbar thumb on the right moves with the scroll.
use: Use it to give the hero or a section photo a sense of depth.

name.ja: スクロールでフェードイン

meaning.en: Elements fade in as they scroll into view
meaning.ru: Блоки всплывают и проявляются, входя в кадр

ask.en: Fade in each section's heading and cards on scroll: up from 30 px below, over 0.6 s.
ask.ru: Скролл: заголовок, карточки и текст всплывают по очереди.

summary: As the page scrolls, the heading, the cards and the body text each rise into place and fade in when they enter the view.
spec: Scroll: 0→95 px at 0.35–1.0 s, 95→200 px at 1.5–2.1 s, 200→0 at 3.2–4.4 s (all cubic ease-in-out).
Trigger line at 85% of the viewport height (143 px from the top). An element fires when its top edge passes above it (the Intersection Observer idea).
After firing, over 0.7 s: opacity 0→1 and offset 28 px below → 0 (cubic ease-out).
Three elements: the heading (172 px down the page), a row of three cards (206 px) and body text (334 px), all below the view at first. The cards in the row appear together.
