When an element leaves the bottom of the view on the way back up, it is reset out of sight and plays again next time.
use: Use it on a long landing page to bring content in piece by piece as the reader scrolls.

meaning.en: The header stays at the top while the page scrolls
meaning.ru: Шапка прилипает к верху, контент едет под ней

ask.en: Make the header a sticky header, with a soft shadow once it sticks to the top.
ask.ru: При скролле шапка сайта остаётся сверху.

summary: The announcement strip scrolls away, but the header below it stops at the top edge and the content scrolls underneath.
spec: Scroll: 0→110 px at 0.4–1.3 s, 110→250 px at 1.9–2.8 s, 250→0 at 3.4–4.4 s (cubic ease-in-out).
At the very top, a 22 px announcement strip (navy); below it a 34 px header (logo, three menu items, button).
Header position = max(22 − scroll, 0): once the strip is gone, it stops at the top edge (position: sticky; top: 0).
Over the next 24 px of scroll, a 12 px shadow under the header fades from 0 to 0.16 opacity.
The content (photo, heading, three cards) scrolls normally under the header.
use: Use it to keep the menu and the call-to-action within reach on a long page.

meaning.en: A section stays fixed while scrolling advances its content
meaning.ru: Секция замирает, а скролл листает её содержимое

ask.en: Pin the three-step section and switch the photo and number one step at a time as the user scrolls.
ask.ru: Секция фиксируется и листает шаги 1 → 2 → 3.

summary: A navy section stops when it fills the view; further scrolling steps the number and photo through 1→2→3, then the section scrolls on.
spec: Scroll: 0→500 px at 0.3–3.0 s, 500→0 at 3.5–4.5 s (cubic ease-in-out).
The section (168 tall, navy) reaches the top at 110 px of scroll and stays there for the next 300 px (a GSAP ScrollTrigger pin).
Progress while pinned: p = (scroll − 110) / 300. A vertical line (124 long) on the left fills in orange with p.
At p = 1/3 and 2/3 (±0.07, cubic ease-in-out) it moves to the next step: the number (46 px) rolls up 52 px and the photo (226 × 124) slides up 124 px.
After 300 px the pin is released and the section scrolls up with the white section below it.
use: Use it to walk through steps, features or a before/after in one screen.

meaning.en: Scrolling down moves the content sideways
meaning.ru: Скролл вниз двигает карточки вбок

ask.en: Turn the work section into a horizontal scroll: move the cards left as far as the user scrolls down.
ask.ru: Портфолио: карточки работ едут влево при скролле.

summary: As the page scrolls down, the section holds still and four numbered work cards travel to the left.
spec: Scroll: 0→420 px at 0.3–3.0 s, 420→0 at 3.5–4.5 s (cubic ease-in-out).
The heading "WORKS" scrolls away; the section reaches the top at 40 px of scroll and stays there.
Cards: four at 200 × 112, gap 20, side padding 34. Horizontal travel = 34·2 + 200·4 + 20·3 − 511 = 417 px.
Card x = start x − p × 417, with p = (scroll − 40) / 380: linear in scroll, no easing.
The scrollbar thumb moves down while the cards move sideways.
use: Use it to show work, case studies or products in a row inside a long vertical page.

meaning.en: Scrolling settles exactly on the next section
meaning.ru: Страница сама доезжает до начала секции

ask.en: Add scroll snap per section, so a small scroll lands on the top of the next section.
ask.ru: Короткий скролл — страница доезжает до следующей секции.

summary: After a small scroll, the page carries itself the rest of the way until the next section's top lines up with the top of the view.
spec: Each section is as tall as the viewport (168 px). The first is pale blue, the second navy.
One snap per 2.4 s. At 0.45–0.85 s the user scrolls only 34 px (cubic ease-out).
At 0.9–1.5 s the page moves the remaining 134 px by itself and lines up the next section's top (cubic ease-out).
The second 2.4 s does the same upward, back to the first section (the behaviour of scroll-snap-type: y mandatory).
use: Use it for a page that should read one full screen at a time, like slides.

name.ja: スクロールプログレスバー

meaning.en: A bar at the top shows how far you have read
meaning.ru: Полоска сверху растёт по мере прокрутки

ask.en: Add a scroll progress bar at the top of the article page, 4 px thick, in the brand orange.
ask.ru: Полоска прогресса чтения сверху.

summary: As the article is read a bit at a time, the line along the top grows from the left and reaches the far end at the bottom of the page.
spec: The article scrolls 0→430 px in four 110 px steps, each moving for 0.45 s then pausing 0.4 s (cubic ease-in-out).
It returns 430→0 at 3.75–4.55 s.
A 6 px bar along the top of the viewport: light grey track, orange fill.
Fill width = 511 px × scroll / 430, the scroll fraction itself (the same as CSS animation-timeline: scroll()).
use: Use it on long articles to show how much is left to read.

name.ja: マーカーアニメーション

meaning.en: A highlighter stroke is drawn under key words
meaning.ru: Жёлтый маркер прорисовывается под ключевыми словами

ask.en: When the key phrase scrolls into view, draw a yellow highlighter animation under it, left to right in 0.8 s.
ask.ru: Ключевые слова подчёркиваются маркером, когда их произносят.

summary: As the copy scrolls into view, a yellow highlighter stroke is drawn left to right across the lower half of the key words.
spec: Scroll: 0→90 px at 0.35–1.0 s, 90→180 px at 1.6–2.2 s, 180→0 at 3.3–4.4 s (cubic ease-in-out).
Two lines of copy (20 px, bold) at 190 px and 290 px down the page, hidden below the view at first.
When a line's top passes the trigger line (80% of the viewport height, 134 px), the stroke under its key words starts.
Stroke: yellow #FFE36B, 11 tall, in the lower part of the text (8 px above to 3 px below the baseline). Width 0 → word width from the left over 0.8 s (cubic ease-out), drawn behind the text.
Lines that leave the bottom of the view are reset out of sight.
use: Use it in landing-page copy to make the one phrase that matters stand out as it is read.

meaning.en: On hover, the element rises with a deeper shadow
meaning.ru: Карточка приподнимается, тень расползается

ask.en: Give the cards a hover lift: up 8 px with a deeper shadow, over 0.3 s.
ask.ru: Курсор наводится — карточка приподнимается с тенью.

summary: Only the card under the cursor lifts slightly and its shadow spreads; it settles back when the cursor leaves.
spec: Three cards (146 × 128, radius 10). The cursor rests on each, left to right, for about 1 s.
On hover the card rises 10 px over 0.3 s (cubic ease-out); on leave it returns over the same 0.3 s (like a CSS transition).
Shadow, changed together with the lift: blur 6→22 px, y offset 2→12 px, opacity 0.08→0.22.
Light grey page, white cards, so the shadow reads.
use: Use it to make cards and buttons look clickable.

meaning.en: The photo enlarges inside a fixed frame
meaning.ru: Фото увеличивается внутри неподвижной рамки

ask.en: Add an image zoom on hover to the work photos: fixed frame, content to 1.1× over 0.5 s.
ask.ru: Наведение — фото внутри рамки медленно увеличивается.

summary: The photo under the cursor slowly enlarges while its frame stays the same size, and shrinks back when the cursor leaves.
spec: Two photo frames, 222 × 118 (radius 8). The cursor rests on the left one, then the right one, for about 1.5 s each.
On hover the content scales 1→1.15 from the centre over 0.5 s (cubic ease-out); on leave it returns over 0.5 s.
Anything outside the frame is clipped (overflow: hidden). The frame and the caption do not move.
use: Use it on photo grids (work, products, articles) to show which item is about to be chosen.

meaning.en: A shape trails the mouse pointer with a delay
meaning.ru: Кружок следует за курсором с задержкой

ask.en: Add a cursor follower across the site: a 30 px orange circle that trails the pointer slightly.
ask.ru: Оранжевый кружок догоняет курсор.

summary: As the cursor moves around the page, an orange circle follows it a little behind.
spec: Cursor path: x = 255 + 175·sin(2πt/4.8), y = 86 + 46·sin(4πt/4.8) (a figure eight lying on its side, one lap per 4.8 s).
Circle: radius 17, orange, opacity 0.88, drawn under the cursor.
Follow rule: every frame (60 fps) it covers 12% of the remaining distance (x += (cursor x − x) × 0.12).
The arrow cursor stays visible.
use: Use it on brand sites and portfolios to add a playful, hands-on feel.

name.ja: マグネティックボタン

meaning.en: The button is pulled toward a nearby cursor
meaning.ru: Кнопка тянется к курсору и пружинит назад

ask.en: Make the contact button a magnetic button: move 0.3× toward the cursor, and spring back when it leaves.
ask.ru: CTA-кнопка магнитом тянется к курсору.

summary: As the cursor comes near, the button is drawn toward it and follows; when the cursor leaves, the button wobbles back to its place.
spec: A 168 × 52 button (orange, radius 26) in the centre. The pull range is a 110 px radius from the button's centre.
Inside the range: target offset = (cursor − button centre) × 0.35; every frame (60 fps) the button covers 18% of the way to the target.
On leaving the range it returns from its current offset to 0 over 1.1 s with elastic.out(1, 0.3): 2^(−10x)·sin((x − 0.075)·2π/0.3) + 1.
The cursor enters from the left, circles the button and leaves to the right.
use: Use it on the one button you most want clicked, such as sign-up or contact.

meaning.en: A ripple spreads from the point that was pressed
meaning.ru: От точки клика расходится круг

ask.en: Add a ripple effect to the submit button: a white circle spreads from the click point and fades in 0.6 s.
ask.ru: Клик по кнопке — белая рябь из точки нажатия.

summary: Each click sends a white circle out from the click point to fill the button, then it fades away.
spec: Button 280 × 56 (orange, radius 10). Clicks at 0.7 s (left of centre) and 2.9 s (right of centre).
The circle is centred on the click point; its radius grows from 0 to the distance to the button's farthest corner over 0.6 s (cubic ease-out).
White at 0.4 opacity, fading to 0 between 0.3 and 0.8 s after the click.
The circle is clipped to the button (overflow: hidden); the label sits above it.
use: Use it to confirm a press on a button or list item right where it happened.

meaning.en: A link's underline grows from the left on hover
meaning.ru: Линия растёт под ссылкой и уходит вправо

ask.en: Add an underline animation to the menu links: grow from the left in 0.3 s on hover, and exit to the right on leave.
ask.ru: Под словом растёт подчёркивание слева направо.

summary: Under the link the cursor is on, an orange line grows from the left; when the cursor leaves, the line shrinks away to the right.
spec: Three links (20 px, bold, 56 apart). The cursor rests on each, left to right, for about 1 s (hit area 6 px wider than the text on each side).
Underline: orange, 3 thick, 8 px below the baseline.
On hover, width 0→100% from the left end over 0.3 s (cubic ease-out).
On leave, the left end moves right over 0.3 s, so the line exits to the right (like scaleX with transform-origin on the right).
use: Use it on menu and text links to show where the pointer is, quietly.

name.ja: ビフォーアフタースライダー

meaning.en: Drag a divider to compare before and after
meaning.ru: Перетаскиваемая граница между «до» и «после»

ask.en: Show the project photos as a before/after slider: drag the middle line to compare before on the left and after on the right.
ask.ru: Слайдер до/после по фото, туда и обратно.

summary: Dragging the line in the middle of the photo left and right changes how much of the grey "before" (left) and the coloured "after" (right) is shown.
spec: Photo frame 359 × 140 (radius 10). Right: the edited photo in colour. Left: the same photo as the "before" (saturation removed, navy at 0.18 opacity on top).
The before image is clipped to the left of the divider. On the divider: a white line (3 wide) and a white circle (radius 17) with left/right arrows.
At 0.7 s the circle is grabbed; the divider goes 50%→20% (0.75–1.55 s) →82% (1.55–2.65 s) →50% (2.65–3.55 s), all cubic ease-in-out.
Released at 3.62 s. Labels BEFORE (top left) and AFTER (top right).
use: Use it on pages that sell a change: renovation, beauty, photo retouching.

name.ja: 離脱防止ポップアップ

meaning.en: A popup shown when the visitor is about to leave
meaning.ru: Курсор уходит вверх — всплывает «Подождите!»

ask.en: Add an exit-intent popup to the landing page: when the cursor leaves through the top, show a coupon popup once.
ask.ru: Мок сайта: курсор к крестику — попап со скидкой.

summary: When the cursor heads out through the top of the page (toward the tabs and close button), the page dims and a "Wait!" popup opens. The × closes it.
spec: The cursor rises from the page toward the browser's address bar at 0.7–1.25 s (cubic ease-in-out).
It fires when the cursor crosses the top edge of the viewport (y = 0, at about 1.07 s), the same test as mouseleave on document with clientY ≤ 0.
Opens 0.05–0.45 s after firing (cubic ease-out): backdrop navy 0→0.5 opacity; popup (260 × 132, radius 12) opacity 0→1 and scale 0.9→1.
Inside: a heading, a discount line (orange), a coupon button and an × at the top right.
Click on the × at 2.9 s; it disappears 0.03–0.25 s later (linear).
use: Use it to make one last offer to visitors who are about to leave without converting.

meaning.en: A screen shown while the page loads
meaning.ru: Проценты 0 → 100%, затем экран уходит вверх

ask.en: Make a preloader for the site: logo and a percentage, and the screen lifts away at 100%.
ask.ru: Интро как прелоадер: 0–100% и шторка вверх.

summary: On a navy screen the number under the logo counts from 0% to 100%; then the screen lifts away and the page underneath fades in.
spec: A navy screen fills the viewport with a logo, a number (28 px) and a bar (180 × 4).
0→100% at 0.25–2.1 s (cubic ease-out, rounded to whole numbers); the bar fills in orange at the same rate.
At 2.3–2.85 s the whole screen moves up 168 px and out (cubic ease-in-out).
The page heading and photo fade in 0→1 and rise from 14 px below at 2.35–2.95 s (cubic ease-out).
At 4.25–4.75 s the screen comes back down from the top, at 0% (the next load).
use: Use it on image- or video-heavy sites to turn the loading wait into a brand moment.

meaning.en: Images load only when they come into view
meaning.ru: Заглушки со спиннером, картинки проявляются по мере загрузки

ask.en: Lazy load the gallery images: grey placeholders until loaded, then fade in over 0.3 s.
ask.ru: Сетка фото проявляется по мере «загрузки».

summary: As grey placeholders scroll into view, a spinner turns in each, and the images fade in as they arrive. The top row is loaded from the start.
spec: A 3 × 3 grid of 151 × 92 placeholders; the first row is shown from the start. Scroll: 0→110 px at 0.35–1.1 s, 110→225 px at 1.7–2.5 s, 225→0 at 3.5–4.5 s (cubic ease-in-out).
Loading starts when a placeholder's top edge passes above the bottom of the viewport (168 px), with each column 0.12 s later than the one to its left.
For 0.45 s a spinner (radius 11, one turn per 0.8 s) turns in the placeholder's centre.
Then the image fades in 0→1 over 0.35 s (cubic ease-out). Unloaded placeholders show an image icon.
Placeholders that leave the bottom of the view are reset out of sight.
use: Use it on image-heavy pages to make the first view load faster.

meaning.en: More items load automatically at the bottom
meaning.ru: Внизу спиннер, потом подгружаются новые пункты

ask.en: Make the news list an infinite scroll: show a spinner at the bottom and add ten items at a time.
ask.ru: Лента докручивается — спиннер — ещё три поста.

summary: Scrolling down to the end of the list brings up a spinner, then three new items are added so reading can go on.
spec: A list of items (331 × 44, radius 8, 52 apart) with a spinner (radius 10, one turn per 0.8 s) under the last item.
Scroll: 38→116 px at 0.25–0.85 s, 116→194 px at 1.15–1.75 s (cubic ease-in-out); it stops with the end of the list in view.
At 2.6 s three items are added: each fades 0→1 and rises from 10 px below over 0.35 s (cubic ease-out). The spinner moves to the new end.
Each cycle advances by three items (156 px). The content repeats every three items, so the end of the cycle looks the same as the start.
use: Use it for feeds and news lists that people should keep reading without paging.

name.ja: ページ遷移アニメーション

meaning.en: An animation that bridges two pages
meaning.ru: Цветная панель проезжает и открывает новую страницу

ask.en: Add a page transition: on link click, an orange panel sweeps across left to right and the next page appears.
ask.ru: Клик по карточке — оранжевая панель-переход на страницу проекта.

summary: Clicking a card in the work list sweeps an orange panel across from the left; the URL changes and the panel exits to the right on the detail page. "Back to list" returns the same way.
spec: Click on a card at 0.8 s. At 0.9–1.3 s a panel (orange, full viewport, logo in the centre) enters from the left and covers everything (cubic ease-in-out).
At 1.3 s, while covered, the page and the URL in the address bar (/works → /works/02) switch.
At 1.4–1.85 s the panel exits to the right (cubic ease-in-out).
Click on "← Back to list" at 3.0 s: the panel enters at 3.1–3.5 s, the page switches at 3.5 s and the panel exits at 3.6–4.05 s.
The panel covers the whole viewport, header included.
use: Use it on brand sites and portfolios to link one page to the next.

meaning.en: In-page links glide to their target instead of jumping
meaning.ru: Страница плавно доезжает до раздела

ask.en: Make the menu's in-page links smooth scroll, stopping below the fixed header.
ask.ru: Клик «Цены» — страница плавно едет к ценам.

summary: Clicking "Pricing" in the menu glides the page down to the pricing section; the up arrow at the bottom right glides it back to the top.
spec: At 0.9 s the "Pricing" menu item is clicked; scroll goes 0→296 px over 0.95–2.0 s (1.05 s, cubic ease-in-out).
Stop position = top of the pricing section (330 px) − fixed header height (34 px).
Once scroll passes 60 px, a round back-to-top button (radius 15) fades in over the next 40 px at the bottom right.
At 3.1 s that button is clicked; scroll goes 296→0 over 3.15–4.2 s (cubic ease-in-out).
While the pricing section is in view, "Pricing" in the menu turns orange.
use: Use it when a menu or table of contents jumps within the same page, so the reader sees where they went.

meaning.en: Text or logos scroll across in an endless band
meaning.ru: Крупный текст бесконечно едет влево

ask.en: Run the service names in a marquee from right to left, looping without a gap, at about 80 px per second.
ask.ru: Бегущая строка с услугами через оранжевые точки.

summary: Inside a navy band, large service names separated by orange dots keep moving to the left without a gap.
spec: Band: 58 tall, navy, full viewport width. Text: 30 px, heavy weight, 1 px letter spacing, white.
One set is four words (WEB DESIGN / BRANDING / MOTION / UI/UX), 64 px apart, with an orange dot (radius 6) in each gap.
Each cycle (4.8 s) moves left by the width of one set (about 881 px here) at constant speed. The set is measured and the offset wraps by that width, so there is no visible seam.
The set is repeated until the viewport width is filled.
use: Use it to show service names, client logos or a tagline with energy.

name.ja: グラデーションアニメーション

meaning.en: Background colours keep drifting and blending
meaning.ru: Цветные пятна медленно плавают и смешиваются

ask.en: Give the hero an animated gradient background: orange and blue slowly blending, one loop every 10 s.
ask.ru: За заголовком — живой градиент, оранжевый и голубой.

summary: Behind the headline, soft patches of orange, light orange, blue and light blue drift in circles and keep blending differently.
spec: Base colour #FFF1EB, with four radial gradients on top (centre colour → transparent at the edge, each at 0.85 opacity).
Orange (radius 230), light orange #FFB08F (210), blue (240), light blue #9DB6FB (200).
Each centre travels an ellipse once per 4.8 s (x radii 70, 60, 80, 50; y radii 30, 40, 30, 35; start angles 0, 2.1, 4.2, 1.0 rad).
A white headline (34 px) and a button sit on top; only the gradient moves.
use: Use it to add movement and colour behind a hero or heading without using a photo.

name.ja: ふわふわアニメーション

meaning.en: Elements bob gently up and down
meaning.ru: Объекты мягко покачиваются вверх-вниз вразнобой

ask.en: Give the phone image in the hero a floating animation: 8 px up and down, one bob every 2.4 s.
ask.ru: Телефон и плашки рядом мягко парят вразнобой.

summary: Next to the headline, a phone, a heart badge and a rating chip each bob gently out of step, and the shadow under the phone grows and shrinks.
spec: Phone (92 × 132): y = −8·sin(2πt/2.4), one bob per 2.4 s; a sine slows at both ends.
Heart badge (radius 20): y = −6·sin(2πt/1.6 + 1.2). Rating chip (76 × 30): y = −6·sin(2πt/2.4 + 2.4).
Shadow under the phone (54 × 6 ellipse): size and opacity scale by (1 + y/40), so it shrinks and fades as the phone rises.
Both periods (2.4 s and 1.6 s) divide 4.8 s, so the loop has no seam.
use: Use it to add quiet motion to product images, app mockups or decorative icons.

meaning.en: The light source sits behind the subject
meaning.ru: Солнце за героем: светящийся контур и тёплая дымка

ask.en: Backlit portrait of a person in a meadow, the low sun right behind their head, glowing hair outline and soft haze.
ask.ru: Контровое солнце за героем, тёплая дымка, светлый контур.

summary: The sun moves from outside the frame to directly behind the person's head; a thin bright edge appears around the figure, a pale warm haze covers the frame and the side facing the camera darkens.
spec: Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair). light is a flat amber #FFC75A shape, shadow a flat #33405A one
Sun: radius 20 px, from outside the frame (top left, x 40, y −40) to directly behind the head (x 270, y 56), with flat rings of 2.6× and 1.7× the radius (#FFE3A3 at 35% and 60%)
Outline: the figure is stroked with a 7 px line and then filled, leaving a 3.5 px bright edge outside it
Figure #4D5A75 → #33405A; sky #FAF9F7 → #FFF4DC; #FFE3A3 laid over the whole frame at 22%
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
use: For airy, glowing portraits or any image that should feel bathed in light.

meaning.en: A light from behind that outlines the subject's edge
meaning.ru: Темно, только тонкие яркие края по силуэту

ask.en: Portrait on a black background with rim lights from both rear sides; the face stays dark and only the outline of the head and shoulders glows.
ask.ru: Тёмный фон, у героя — тонкий рим-лайт с двух сторон.

summary: The surroundings go dark and two lights behind the person, left and right, draw thin bright edges only along both sides of the head and shoulders; the plan at the bottom right shows where the two lights are.
spec: Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair).
Background: light scene → dark scene (sky #2B2D33, ground #24252A); figure #4D5A75 → #1F2128
Bright edges: two copies of the figure in amber #FFC75A, shifted 3.5 px left and right and 2.5 px up, placed behind the dark figure (3.5 px wide edges)
Plan at the bottom right (66×66 px): lights at ±135° seen from above (behind, left and right); top-right readout "±135°"
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
use: To separate a person or product from a dark background and show its shape.

meaning.en: The subject shows as a black shape against a bright sky
meaning.ru: Экспозиция по небу — объекты становятся чёрными формами

ask.en: Silhouette of a person jumping on a beach at sunset; expose for the sky so the person and the palm tree turn pure black.
ask.ru: Герой — чёрный силуэт на фоне заката.

summary: As the exposure is set for the bright evening sky, the person, buildings, lamp and tree turn into flat black shapes with no detail and only the sky stays bright.
spec: Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair).
Sky: #FAF9F7 → #FFEDC4 at the top and a #FFCF73 band near the horizon (y 92–150)
Everything but the sky becomes #2A2D36, the far hills #4A4546; the figure #22252D
Sun: radius 20 px at x 404, sinking from y 60 to y 128, half hidden by the hills
Top-right readout: ±0.0 EV → −2.0 EV

name.ja: スプリットライティング

meaning.en: Light from the side splits the face into lit and dark halves
meaning.ru: Свет строго сбоку делит лицо пополам

ask.en: Portrait with split lighting: the light at 90° to the side, the face divided down the nose, the far half in shadow.
ask.ru: Портрет со сплит-светом: половина лица в тени.

summary: The light swings from near the front (20°) to directly at the side (90°); the shadow on the head grows from a crescent to exactly half, splitting the face down the middle.
spec: Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair). the background drops to a darker scene (sky #E7E5E1)
Light: from the left of the frame, angle 20° → 90° (plan at the bottom right, top-right readout "90° · ↑0°")
Head: right of x = 270 + cos(angle)·√(29² − dy²) is shadow #33405A, left is light #FFC75A; at 90° the edge is the straight centre line
Body (half-width 56 px): right of x = 270 + cos(angle)·56 is shadow, a strip on the left edge is lit
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
use: For dramatic, tense or moody portraits.

name.ja: レンブラントライティング

meaning.en: High side light that leaves a lit triangle on the shadow cheek
meaning.ru: Свет 45°: в тени щеки остаётся светлый треугольник

ask.en: Portrait of an old man in Rembrandt lighting: light from 45° to the side and above, leaving a small triangle of light on the shadow-side cheek.
ask.ru: Рембрандтовский свет на портрете.

summary: A light 45° to the side and 45° up comes on; the right side of the face falls into shadow except for a small inverted triangle of light on the shadow-side cheek.
spec: Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair). the background drops to a darker scene (sky #E7E5E1)
Head: right of x = 270 + 0.04·29 is shadow #33405A, left is light #FFC75A
Light triangle: (x 270+0.24R, y 78−0.12R), (x 270+0.7R, y 78−0.12R), (x 270+0.24R, y 78+0.5R) with R = 29 (about 13 px wide, 18 px tall), separated from the lit side by a shadow strip about 6 px wide
Body: lit left of centre −0.45×56 px, shadow right of +0.3×56 px; plan shows the light at 45°, top-right readout "45° · ↑45°"
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
use: For portraits with a painterly, sculpted, classic look.

name.ja: バタフライライティング

meaning.en: High frontal light that casts a butterfly shadow under the nose
meaning.ru: Свет спереди сверху: ровное лицо, тень под носом и подбородком

ask.en: Beauty portrait with butterfly lighting: light straight in front and 45° above, a small butterfly-shaped shadow under the nose.
ask.ru: Бьюти-свет «бабочка».

summary: A light in front of the face and high above comes on; the face lights evenly on both sides and only a small symmetrical shadow falls under the chin.
spec: Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair). the background drops to a darker scene (sky #E7E5E1)

meaning.en: The low, warm light just after sunrise or before sunset
meaning.ru: Солнце у горизонта, всё оранжевое, длинные тени

ask.en: A person in a field at golden hour: the sun near the horizon, long shadows, everything warm orange.
ask.ru: Грейд «золотой час»: тёплый, длинные тени.

spec: Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair).

meaning.en: The time after sunset or before sunrise when the sky turns deep blue
meaning.ru: После заката: глубокий синий и тёплые окна

ask.en: Harbour city at blue hour: deep blue sky, warm windows and streetlights reflected in the water.
ask.ru: Финал в синем часе: синее небо, жёлтые окна.

summary: Once the sun has set, the sky turns two bands of deep blue, the windows and street lamp come on in amber and the person becomes a dark blue shape.
spec: Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair).
Sun: radius 18 px at x 120, sinking from y 40 to y 190 while the effect reaches 70%, fading out between 40% and 80%
Colour: sky #2C3B5E at the top and #4A6191 near the horizon, ground #283452, buildings #34446B, figure #1C2439
Lights: one window in three and the lamp bulb turn #FFC75A; flat rings of 13 px and 8 px (#FFE3A3 at 35% and 60%) around the bulb
Top-right time 12:00 → 18:35
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
use: For city and night scenes that need both a blue sky and glowing lights.

meaning.en: Out-of-focus points of light melt into soft discs
meaning.ru: Фон размыт, огни превращаются в мягкие диски

ask.en: Person in a city at night with big round bokeh from the street lights behind; f/1.4, focus on the person.
ask.ru: За заголовком — тёплое боке.

summary: As the aperture opens, the in-focus person stays sharp, the buildings behind soften and the street lamps and distant lights spread into large, pale discs.
spec: Scene 2: a street corner; buildings, trees and street lamps (x 114, 292, 494) behind a road at y 132–162; the person stands front left (feet at x 176, y 200, 124 px tall). the background drops to a darker scene (sky #E7E5E1)
Background blur (everything but the person): 0 → 6 px
Lights: the three lamps (size 1.25) and 12 more spaced 45 px apart (y 44–114, size 0.6–1.2, fixed seed); disc radius = (2.4 + 15 × effect) × size
Discs: opacity 100% → 55%, lamps amber #FFC75A, distant lights #FFE3A3, with a 1.2 px amber rim
The person stays sharp; top-right aperture f/16 → f/1.4 (8 stops)
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
use: To lift a person or product off the background and add a soft, festive night mood.

meaning.en: Blur top and bottom so a real scene looks like a miniature
meaning.ru: Размыты верх и низ — улица выглядит как макет

ask.en: High-angle view of a town with a tilt-shift look: a narrow sharp band across the middle, strong blur above and below, boosted colour, like a miniature model.
ask.ru: Город с тилт-шифтом, как игрушечный.

summary: The top and bottom bands of the street blur while only the middle band with the road, the car and the small people stays in focus, so the street looks like a model.
spec: The street corner (buildings, trees and lamps behind a road at y 132–162) without the large person; four small people 23–26 px tall stand on the pavement (feet at y 172); the car drives from x −60 to 600 every 5 s
Focus band: y 66–176 stays sharp
Blur: y 0–42 and y 190–208 go 0 → 7 px; y 42–66 and y 176–190 go 0 → 3 px
Dashed lines on the band edges (6 px dash, 5 px gap, #8E8E93 at 75%)
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
use: To make a city or event look like a toy model world.

meaning.en: Keep the shutter open long so moving lights become lines
meaning.ru: Движущееся исчезает, фары превращаются в линии

ask.en: Night road as a long exposure, 8-second shutter: the cars disappear and only their headlights and tail lights remain as white and red trails.
ask.ru: Ночная улица с длинной выдержкой: линии фар.

summary: The street turns to night; the moving car fades to almost nothing, a red tail-light line stretches out behind it and white and amber lines run along the opposite lane.
spec: Scene 2: a street corner; buildings, trees and street lamps (x 114, 292, 494) behind a road at y 132–162; the person stands front left (feet at x 176, y 200, 124 px tall). colours go to night (sky #2C3B5E, one window in three #FFC75A)
Car: x −60 → 600 every 5 s; body opacity 100% → 10%
Tail-light line: from x −60 to the car: #FF5B4D 2.6 px at y 145 and #FF8A6E 1.4 px at y 149
Opposite lane: full-width lines #FFE9B8 2.6 px at y 135, #FFC75A 1.6 px at y 138.5 and #FFE9B8 1.2 px at y 141.5 (they fade in with the effect)
Top-right shutter speed 1/250 → 8″
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
use: To show traffic flow, or silky water and clouds, in a single still.

meaning.en: Follow a moving subject so only the background streaks
meaning.ru: Объект резкий, фон смазан по направлению движения

ask.en: Panning shot of a red car driving past, 1/15 s shutter: the car sharp, the trees and buildings behind streaked sideways.
ask.ru: Машина резкая, фон смазан в проводке.

summary: The camera follows the moving car: the car stays sharp in the middle of the frame while only the buildings, trees and lamps behind it streak sideways.
spec: Street corner: buildings, trees and lamps behind a road at y 132–162 (no large person in front)
Car: without the effect it drives from x −80 to 620 in 5 s; with it, it stays at x 270 ±10 px
Streak: the background is drawn 12 times spread over 46 px sideways and averaged (spread 0 → 46 px)
Wheels: a spoke line turns 12 times per 5 s
Top-right shutter speed 1/1000 → 1/15
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
use: To show the speed of a car, bike or runner in a still photo.

meaning.en: Rings and spots of light from a bright source in the lens
meaning.ru: Лучи от солнца и цепочка бликов через кадр

ask.en: Mountain landscape with the sun in frame and lens flare: coloured ghosts lined up from the sun through the centre to the opposite side.
ask.ru: Анаморфный блик на появлении логотипа.

summary: As the sun comes out from behind a building, rays appear around it and a line of light dots, hexagons and a ring runs from the sun through the centre of the frame to the opposite side.
spec: Scene 2: a street corner; buildings, trees and street lamps (x 114, 292, 494) behind a road at y 132–162; the person stands front left (feet at x 176, y 200, 124 px tall).
Sun: radius 13 px, from behind a building (x 428, y 74) to open sky (x 474, y 30)
Rays: 8, from 17 px out from the centre of the sun to 26 px or 44 px, alternating (9 px and 27 px long; amber, 1.6 px, 75%)

Flare: on the line from the sun through the centre at t = 0.45, 0.8, 1.15, 1.45, 1.75 and 2.0 (t = 1 is the centre): a 7 px circle, a 13 px hexagon, a 5 px circle, a 22 px hexagon, a 9 px circle and a 30 px ring (3 px line)
Colours amber #FFC75A and #FFE3A3 at 40–70% × the effect
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
use: To add glare, summer sunshine or a cinematic light feel.

meaning.en: Ultra-wide lens that bulges the centre and bends straight lines
meaning.ru: Центр выпирает, линии выгибаются наружу

ask.en: City street through a fisheye lens, 180° view, the building edges bowing outward.
ask.ru: Фишай-искажение в скейт-эдите.

summary: The middle of the street scene bulges out; the vertical lines of the buildings and the lines of the road bow outward while the corners stay where they are.
spec: Scene 2: a street corner; buildings, trees and street lamps (x 114, 292, 494) behind a road at y 132–162; the person stands front left (feet at x 176, y 200, 124 px tall).
Warp: a point at distance d from the centre moves to g = (1 + k) / (1 + k·d²/R²) times that distance, R = distance from the centre to a corner (289 px)
k: 0 → 1.25; the centre is magnified 2.25×, the corners do not move
Every outline is cut every 6 px before warping, so straight lines become curves
Top-right focal length 24mm → 8mm
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
use: For bold, playful or peephole-like views (skateboarding, music videos).

meaning.en: Red and blue-violet colour fringes along high-contrast edges
meaning.ru: Красная и голубая кайма по краям объектов

ask.en: Black branches against a white sky with slight chromatic aberration: red and blue-violet fringes on the edges, stronger toward the corners.
ask.ru: Лёгкая хроматика по краям, сильнее на ударах.

summary: The street scene is split into red, green and blue and the three are laid back together at slightly different sizes, so red and cyan fringes appear on the edges of the person, buildings and lamps, larger towards the sides.
spec: Scene 2: a street corner; buildings, trees and street lamps (x 114, 292, 494) behind a road at y 132–162; the person stands front left (feet at x 176, y 200, 124 px tall).
Split: the image is multiplied by red #FF0000, green #00FF00 and blue #0000FF into three copies and added back together over black
Scale about the centre: red 1 + 2s, green 1 + s, blue 1, with s = 0 → 0.02
Offset: red and blue end up about 11 px apart at the left and right edges, 0 at the centre
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
use: To add an imperfect old-lens, VHS or glitch feel.

meaning.en: The corners darken and draw the eye to the centre
meaning.ru: Края кадра плавно темнеют

ask.en: Beach photo with a strong vignette: the corners darken gradually so the eye goes to the person in the middle.
ask.ru: Мягкая виньетка на всё видео.

summary: The frame darkens smoothly from the corners while the person and the road in the middle stay bright.
spec: Scene 2: a street corner; buildings, trees and street lamps (x 114, 292, 494) behind a road at y 132–162; the person stands front left (feet at x 176, y 200, 124 px tall).

meaning.ru: Светлая картинка почти без теней

ask.ru: Светлый воздушный хай-ки грейд.

summary: The landscape and the person turn to light, near-white colours with very faint shadows, and the hump of the histogram at the bottom right moves to the right end.

meaning.en: Pulls back briefly before moving forward
meaning.ru: Перед рывком объект отклоняется назад и сжимается

ask.en: Add anticipation before the button shoots off to the right: pull back slightly for 0.3 s, squash, then go.
ask.ru: Перед вылетом слово делает замах назад.

summary: A square character pulls back against its direction of travel, squashes to wind up, then shoots forward.
spec: One move per 2.35 s (twice per 4.7 s: left to right, then right to left). A coral rounded square (86 px, radius 24) with a white arrow. It starts 108 px from the edge; the floor is at y = 178.
Wind-up: 0.2–0.95 s, quadratic ease-in-out. It backs off 44 px against the direction of travel, squashes to 1.22 wide × 0.76 tall and leans back 0.18 rad.

Launch: 0.95–1.38 s (0.43 s). From the backed-off position to the far end with backOut (s = 1.1), a slight overshoot. In the first 60% of the move it stretches up to 1.55 wide × 0.72 tall (half sine) and leans forward 0.08 rad.
Landing: from 1.38 s, width and height wobble in opposite directions by 0.13·e^(−7t)·sin(17t).
At launch, three dust puffs at the start point (gone within the first 70% of the move) and three yellow speed lines (width 8) behind it.
use: Use it just before a jump, dash or launch to give the move build-up and weight.

meaning.en: Parts keep swinging after the body stops
meaning.ru: Объект остановился, а хвост и детали ещё качаются

ask.en: Give the hair and the flag follow-through after the character stops: they keep swinging for about 0.5 s, then settle.
ask.ru: После остановки флажок ещё качается и успокаивается.

summary: A round character slides in and stops suddenly; only the flag on its head and its tail keep swinging, then settle.
spec: One move per 2.35 s (twice per 4.7 s, alternating direction). The body is a mint circle (radius 38). It travels 303 px at 0.15–0.85 s: it speeds up over the first 30%, then keeps a constant speed and stops abruptly at 0.85 s.

Flag (58 px white pole with a yellow flag): its angle is a spring pushed by the body's acceleration, a″ = −121a − 5.5a′ − 0.0175 × acceleration (natural frequency 11 rad/s). The cloth bends a further 0.6 × the pole angle.

Tail: seven 14 px segments (coral, width 14→6) on a slower spring, b″ = −56b − 2.8b′ − 0.012 × acceleration. Segment j uses the value from j × 22/600 s (about 0.037 s) earlier, scaled by (0.55 + 0.16j).
Both springs are precomputed in 1/600 s steps; drawing only looks values up.
In the last 0.3 s of each move the swing is faded to 0 with smoothstep, so the loop has no seam.
use: Use it on hair, clothes, accessories or the trim of a logo, so that the parts attached to the main body feel weighted.

meaning.en: Falls and bounces lower until it stops
meaning.ru: Мяч падает и отскакивает всё ниже

ask.en: Drop the ball from the top with a bounce: three bounces, each lower than the last.
ask.ru: Иконка падает с тремя затухающими отскоками.

summary: A ball drops and bounces lower each time until it comes to rest.
spec: One drop per 2.35 s (twice per 4.7 s: yellow first, then coral). The ball has radius 26.
From 0.1 s it falls from 190 px above the floor. Gravity 1900 px/s²; each bounce keeps 56% of the speed (restitution 0.56); it stops when the rebound speed is below 35 px/s.
Sideways it moves x = 150→390 over 0.1–1.8 s with cubic ease-out.

Squash for 0.045 s either side of each impact: width 1 + sq, height 1 − sq, with sq up to 0.4 × min(1, impact speed ÷ 850). Impacts faster than 200 px/s flick short white lines left and right for 0.3 s.
The shadow gets smaller with height. Exit: 1.95–2.25 s, scale multiplied by (1 − backIn, s = 2).
use: Use it whenever something drops and lands: an icon, a word or a product that should feel heavy and springy.

meaning.en: Shakes in small, random, continuous jitters
meaning.ru: Непрерывное мелкое неровное дрожание

ask.en: Add a subtle wiggle to the notification bell, up to about 10°, for as long as it rings.
ask.ru: Колокольчик постоянно мелко дрожит.

summary: A bell keeps jittering irregularly: not one hit, but a small shake that never stops.
spec: A yellow bell pivoting at its top (centre, y = 34). It never stops moving.

Angle = the sum of four sine waves: 23, 31, 43 and 59 cycles per 4.7 s (about 4.9, 6.6, 9.1 and 12.6 Hz), amplitudes 0.085, 0.065, 0.05 and 0.035 rad (up to about 0.235 rad, 13.5°, when they line up).
Position also jitters: x with 29, 47 and 61 cycles (4, 3, 2 px), y with 37 and 53 cycles (2.4, 1.8 px).
Every frequency is a whole number of cycles per 4.7 s, so the loop joins up; the counts share no common factor, so it does not look regular.
The clapper (coral, radius 13) swings the other way (angle × 70 px). White vibration arcs (radius 86 and 110, width 6) flicker on both sides the whole time.
use: Use it on a notification, an incoming call or anything that should catch the eye, or to add a restless, handheld feel.

meaning.en: Its size throbs like a heartbeat

summary: A heart throbs like a heartbeat, a double beat each time, with rings spreading out.
spec: A coral heart. One beat per 1.175 s (four per 4.7 s); each beat is a double "lub-dub".
Scale = 1 + 0.26·G(0.2 s, width 0.065) + 0.15·G(0.44 s, width 0.07), where G = e^(−((t − centre) ÷ width)²): a quick swell that drops straight back.
Two heart-shaped outlines spread from 0.16 s and 0.40 s: scale 1.2→2.4 over 0.8 s, cubic ease-out.

summary: A paper plane follows a dotted path, turning as it goes and looping the loop on the way.
spec: One pass per 4.7 s, from off-screen left to off-screen right. The path is x = 270 + 112θ − 150·sinθ, y = 106 − 74·cosθ for θ = −π→π, which makes a loop at the top centre.
θ advances in proportion to time (so the speed along the path is not constant; the loop looks slower).
The plane turns to the path direction: angle = atan2(74·sinθ, 112 − 150·cosθ).
The path is shown in advance as a dotted line (width 6, dash 2/15). A mint trail of 24 segments (0.03 in θ each) follows, thinner and fainter towards the back.
use: Use it whenever something should follow a set route: a flying object, a car, a journey on a map.

meaning.en: Plays forward, then backward, over and over

ask.ru: Фон качается пинг-понгом бесконечно.

spec: One round trip per 4.7 s: 2.35 s forward, then the same motion played backwards for 2.35 s (progress g goes 0→1→0, linear).
A mint rounded square (48 px, radius 13) hops from x = 92 to 447 along three arches of height 62·|sin(3πg)|, turning one full turn with g.
Four ghost copies, 0.045 s apart, opacity 0.1–0.4.
A playback bar below: blue with a play label while going forward, coral with a reverse label while going back. The progress bar and its knob follow g.
Vertical posts mark the two turning points.
use: Use it for loaders, idle animations and any move that should repeat back and forth without a cut.

A yellow star (radius 38) hops from x = −44 to 583 along three arches of height 54·|sin(3πt)|, turning twice.
Each frame gets a fixed random jitter: position ±5 px across and ±4.5 px up and down, rotation ±0.15 rad, size ±5%.
The previous two frames stay faintly visible (opacity 0.28 and 0.12), like onion skin.
Black film-strip bands top and bottom (26 px each, with sprocket holes) and a frames-per-second label.

summary: Random characters keep changing, then lock into the right word from left to right.
spec: "HELLO" in the first 2.35 s, "WORLD" in the second. Five monospaced letters (92 px).
Unsettled slots show random characters from A–Z (without I and O), 0–9 and #$%&@?, changing 76 times per 4.7 s (about every 0.062 s), mint at 75% opacity.

summary: The letters of "WAVE TEXT" rise and fall one after another, like a wave.

Vertical offset of letter i = −28·sin(φ − 0.62i), with φ = 2π × 3 × time ÷ 4.7 (each letter lags the previous by 0.62 rad).
Rising letters stretch vertically (1 + 0.06·s) and shift from white towards yellow (s is the sine value, clamped to 0–1 for the colour).
A shadow ellipse under each letter shrinks as the letter rises.

spec: "MOTION" (112 px, system-ui, 2 px letter spacing). The weight goes back and forth twice per 4.7 s: v = 0.5 − 0.5·cos(2π × 2 × time ÷ 4.7), which eases at both ends.
Weight = round(100 + 800v), from 100 to 900, set directly as the font weight.

summary: Heavy letters are cut out so that a moving seascape shows only inside them; near the end of the cycle the whole picture appears.
spec: "OCEAN" (weight 900, system-ui, 2 px letter spacing). The font size starts at 172 px and drops 2 px at a time until the word is at most 500 px wide.

The scene inside keeps moving: coral sky, a yellow sun bobbing ±6 px, blue sea below y = 116 with four white wavy lines drifting 240 px per 4.7 s in alternating directions, a sailboat crossing once per 4.7 s, clouds drifting 60 px.
Method: draw the word on an offscreen canvas, then composite the scene onto it with source-in, so the scene remains only inside the letters. A white 4 px outline around the letters.
Outside the letters the scene shows at 12% opacity; it rises to 100% at 3.45–3.85 s and returns to 12% at 4.25–4.65 s (smoothstep).
use: Use it to show a photo or footage inside a title or brand name, putting the word and the picture together.

meaning.ru: Одна форма размножена по кругу, копии вращаются вразнобой

ask.ru: Логотип размножен по кругу репитером.

summary: One shape is duplicated around a circle, and the copies turn and pulse slightly out of step.
spec: A rounded bar (24 × 60, radius 12) is copied up to 12 times around a circle of radius 58 at the centre, each turned to face outward (angle + 90°).
Count: 1→12 at 0.35–1.7 s and 12→1 at 3.6–4.45 s (quadratic ease-in-out). Each new copy slides from the previous slot to its own, 30° further on (cubic ease-out).
The whole ring turns once per 4.7 s. Each copy pulses in size by 1 ± 0.22 twice per 4.7 s, each one 0.55 rad later than the last, so a ripple runs round the ring.
Colours go blue, coral, yellow, mint. The original copy has a white outline. A "×N" counter at the top right.
use: Use it for loaders, background patterns, flowers or rays: anything built from one shape repeated.

meaning.en: Mirrored patterns spread out symmetrically
meaning.ru: Симметричный узор вращается от центра

ask.en: Put a kaleidoscope behind the logo: 8-way mirror symmetry, turning slowly as it spreads out.
ask.ru: Калейдоскоп из футажа на дропе.

summary: An 8-way symmetrical pattern turns and spreads out from the centre, like a kaleidoscope.
spec: The area around the centre is split into eight 45° wedges; every other wedge is drawn mirrored, giving eight mirror-symmetric sections.
One wedge holds 13 shapes (circles, diamonds, triangles; four colours; fixed random seed). They travel outward from the centre to radius 300, one full radius per 4.7 s, wrapping back to the centre.
Shapes grow as they go out ((5 + 0.1r) × 0.7–1.4) and spin 0.02 rad per px. They fade in over the first 30 px and out over the last 70 px; each sways ±0.08 rad once per 4.7 s.
The whole pattern turns 90° per 4.7 s (two wedges, so the loop joins up).
A white eight-point star at the centre (radius 20 ± 4, pulsing twice per 4.7 s).
use: Use it for music videos, live backdrops or dreamy scene changes, wherever a pattern has to hold up on repeat.

summary: A hand-drawn line picture wobbles every few frames while the picture itself stays still.
spec: A still line drawing (a yellow star, a white cloud, mint sparkle strokes, a faint ground line). Line widths 6–8, round caps.
The drawing does not move. 47 times per 4.7 s (about every 0.1 s) every point is redrawn with a fixed random offset of up to ±3.5 px in x and in y.
Each line is first turned into a row of points (every 6–13 px; 96 points round the cloud) and drawn as quadratic curves through the midpoints between them, so it wobbles like hand-drawn frames.
The offsets are a hash of the frame number and the point number, so the same frame always looks the same.
use: Use it on hand-drawn illustrations, icons or lettering to make even a still picture feel drawn by hand.

meaning.en: The next scene pushes the current one out
meaning.ru: Новая сцена въезжает сбоку и выталкивает старую

ask.en: Go to the next slide with a push transition from the right, 0.8 s.
ask.ru: Пуш-переход снизу вверх для вертикальной ленты.

summary: The next scene slides in from the side and pushes the current one out with it.
spec: Sea scene → mountain scene → sea scene, 2.35 s each. The change runs at 0.45–1.6 s of each half (1.15 s), cubic ease-in-out.
The two scenes stay joined and move together by the full frame width (539 px); no overlap and no fade.
Direction: sea→mountain moves left (the next scene enters from the right); mountain→sea moves right.
A navy line (width 6) marks the seam between the two scenes.
use: Use it to step through slides, photos or steps, when the change should feel continuous and moving forward.

meaning.en: The next scene opens through thin strips
meaning.ru: Тонкие полосы раскрываются и открывают новую сцену

ask.en: Change scenes with a blinds transition: seven horizontal strips that open over 1 s.
ask.ru: Переход жалюзи из 8 полос.

summary: Gaps in a row of thin strips widen until the next scene is fully open.
spec: Day scene → night scene → day, 2.35 s each. Seven horizontal strips (208 ÷ 7 ≈ 29.7 px each).
0.4–1.65 s (1.25 s), quadratic ease-in-out: in every strip at once, the next scene is revealed from the strip's top edge downward, opening from 0 to the full strip height.
The previous scene stays underneath. Neither picture moves.
use: Use it for a clear switch between two scenes, such as day and night or before and after, or for a retro feel.

meaning.en: Changes scenes like a turning cube
meaning.ru: Сцена поворачивается как грань куба

ask.en: Switch the product shots with a cube transition, turning 90° to the left in 0.8 s.
ask.ru: Переход кубом между двумя фичами.

summary: Like a turning cube, the front face swings away and the next face comes round.
spec: Face A (an "A" on coral) and face B (a "B" on mint), each 250 × 146. 2.35 s each, A→B→A.
Rotation 0→90° at 0.45–1.6 s (1.15 s), cubic ease-in-out, around a vertical axis through the centre of the cube (depth equal to the face width, 250).
Perspective: camera distance 820 px. Each face is drawn as 2 px vertical slices, each sized and placed by its perspective factor.
The face turning away darkens up to 55% (0.55·sinφ); the incoming face starts 55% dark and brightens (0.55·cosφ). The floor shadow follows the visible width.
use: Use it to show products, plans or screens one after another with a sense of depth.

meaning.en: Peels back like paper to show the next page
meaning.ru: Страница загибается с угла и открывает следующую

ask.en: Go to the next chapter with a page curl from the bottom-right corner, 1.2 s.
ask.ru: Переход перелистыванием, как в книге.

summary: A page peels back from its corner and folds over, revealing the next page beneath.
spec: Page 1 (white) → page 2 (cream) → page 1, 2.35 s each. The curl starts at the bottom-right corner, 0.35–1.75 s (1.4 s), quadratic ease-in-out.
The fold line moves from the corner in the direction (−1, −0.42), normalised, by 0→600 px.
The part beyond the fold line is mirrored across it to form the flap, the back of the page (light grey or beige), with a drop shadow (blur 14, offset 4, 4) and a white 2 px edge.
The next page shows where the paper has lifted, with a 50 px shadow gradient along the fold.
use: Use it for books, catalogues, albums or chapter breaks, where a paper feel or reading on suits the content.

meaning.en: Turns into coarse blocks, then switches
meaning.ru: Картинка распадается на крупные блоки и собирается обратно

ask.en: Use a pixelate transition: the mosaic gets coarser over 0.6 s and the scene changes at the coarsest point.
ask.ru: Переход пикселизацией через белый.

summary: The picture turns into coarser and coarser blocks, switches at the coarsest point, then sharpens again.
spec: Field scene → city scene → field, 2.35 s each. At 0.2–1.9 s (1.7 s) the block size steps up and back down through 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 11, 15, 20, 27 and 36 px (coarsest at the midpoint, 1.05 s).
The first half shows the old scene and the second half the new one; the swap happens at the coarsest step.
Method: shrink the frame to width ÷ block size with smoothing on, then scale it back up with smoothing off.
use: Use it for game-like, retro or digital scene changes, or to blur something out as the scene switches.

meaning.en: Breaks like glass and the shards fly off
meaning.ru: Кадр трескается, осколки разлетаются

ask.en: Before the title appears, break the previous scene with a shatter: cracks first, then the shards fall away in about 1 s.
ask.ru: На ударе кадр разбивается как стекло.

summary: The picture cracks like glass, the shards fly off and the next scene is revealed.
spec: Mountain scene → day scene → mountain, 2.35 s each. The impact point is (304, 92).

Cracks: 0.3–0.65 s. Thirteen radial lines and rings at radii of about 40, 98 and 175 (each ±15%) appear in order of distance from the centre (cubic ease-out, out to 420 px). A white flash star at the centre fades by 0.6 s.

The glass breaks at 0.82 s: 52 shards (13 × 4 rings) cut from the old scene fly outward at 220–480 px/s (vertical speed × 0.7, plus up to 120 upward), with gravity 1300 px/s², spinning ±4 rad/s and shrinking up to 35% over 1 s.
Outer rings leave later (0.035 s per ring plus up to 0.03 s at random). Each shard fades out 0.55–1.0 s after it starts moving.
Shards have a white 2.5 px edge; the next scene is underneath.
use: Use it for an impact, a break or a twist, just before a title or a result that should hit hard.

meaning.en: Parts separate to show the structure inside
meaning.ru: Устройство расходится на слои и собирается обратно

ask.en: Show an exploded view of the product: four parts spread apart in 1 s, each with a name label.
ask.ru: Телефон раскладывается на слои, показываем устройство.

summary: A phone separates into its layers to show how it is built, then assembles again.
spec: An isometric phone built from four layers (back cover, battery, circuit board, screen). Each layer is a flat rounded plate drawn on axes scaled by 0.85 and tilted 30° either way, with 6 px thick sides.
Separate: from 0.45 s, 0.75 s per layer, each layer 0.08 s after the one below, backOut (s = 1.3). Height of layer i (0–3 from the bottom) = 7i + 30i × progress, so the back cover stays put.
While apart, each layer bobs ±3 px twice per 4.7 s, dotted guide lines join the corners, and name labels with leader lines appear on the right (in Japanese in the demo).
Reassemble: from 3.25 s, 0.7 s per layer, starting with the top layer, 0.07 s apart, cubic ease-in-out.
use: Use it to explain what is inside a product, how it works or what it is made of, at a glance.

name.ja: スプリットスクリーン

meaning.en: Divides the frame to show scenes side by side
meaning.ru: Кадр делится на две или три панели со своими сценами

ask.en: Show three scenes at once with a split screen: from one panel to two, then three, 0.5 s each.
ask.ru: Сплит-скрин на три панели: три сцены одновременно.

summary: One full-frame scene splits into two panels, then three, each with its own scene moving.
spec: A full-frame sea scene splits into two panels at 0.45–0.95 s (divider 539→269.5), then into three at 1.4–1.9 s (dividers at 1/3 and 2/3), and merges back into one at 3.75–4.4 s, all cubic ease-in-out.

The three scenes (sea, city, field) are each centred in and clipped to their own panel and keep moving inside it (waves and a sailboat, city windows switching 8 times per 4.7 s, a windmill turning twice per 4.7 s).
White dividers (width 6) between the panels.
use: Use it to compare, to show things happening at once, or to line up several people or places, such as before and after or a set of options.
